dkar chagadapar skrun gsal bshad/ 511 1 7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po'i sku bcar bla sman slo bzang dbang rgyal mchog gi mdzad 'phrin gnad bsdus brjod pa skal ldan bu slob dgyes pa'i mchod sprin/ 1da gangs can bod kyi gso/ ba rig pa ngo sprodad snying bsdus su bkod pa blo gsar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs/ 133 gasku rtsis dgongs don 'dzam gling che chung gi rnam bshad la dpyad pa be+eḍūr+ya'i rang mdangs/ 255 spar kha brgyad kyi bde mtshon phyag rgya 'bri tshul la dpyad pa cung zad gleng ba gtsug lag smra ba'i lag rjes/ 475 spyi 'o/ dang phyi lo'i tha snyad las 'asgyu sa pa'i dpyad yig ye 'o/ mngon par gsal byed/ 776 'byung ba'i rtsis kyi rnam gzhag las ma bu dgra grogs dang ji ltar ma bu dgra grogs su 'gyur tshul gyi gnas lugs cung zhig gleng ba/ 917 mig 'byed mthong brgyud bla ma'i phyag len gsal bar bkod pa rin chen thur ma'i las snu ga 95

1 5 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig ༷ gas bsdus bzhugs mo //8 mig dbang gsal byed kyi byug pa bo snyedad rin chen gyi rjodar ba dang lag len/ 1038 lus 'cho ba'i rgyu (tshe/ las/ bsku da nams)gsum gyi skor la cung zad bshad pa rgyud don gsal byed rmongs pa'i gros 'debs/ 10710 ye 'o/ (phyi 'o/'am spyi 'o/ )las brgyad cu skor dang / spe 'phreng 'byung 'o/ skyes sme bcas pa 'chosal thabs kyi gab rtse blo gsar byis pa mgu ba'i rtsed 'alnga / 11311 dpal dus kyi 'kho ra lo'i bsdus pa'i rgyud dang de'i rgyas 'grel dri ma med pa'i 'od 'phrul par du bzhengs pa'i sngon gleng / 12712 lo nag gi ngos 'dzin dang sdom bya gto bcas gsal bar b.lo/da pa gtsug lag snang gsal bya ba bzhugs sdu/// 13513 bo dkar dbo ngas don gshin rtsis 'khyer bder gces btus lugs kyi rdel bor bzang ngan dang 'bras bu 'dodan thabs kyi go rim lag tu blang chodag phan bde myur ster bzhugs so// 14114 bod kyi srol rgyun sman rtsis rig gzhung gi ngo spyod dang de las 'phros pa'i gtam srol rgyun dang sdu/la rgyun rig pa'i gzhung lugs la cung zad dpyad pa dus su gleng ba'i ngag ces bya ba bzhugs 11// 145lhan thabs/

dkar chag 1 / tshe rabs las rtsis la nye bar mkho ba'i dus sgror brtsi thabs mtshungs med bla ma'i zhal lung / 173dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa sangs lhun grub/16 dpal dus kyi 'khor lo'i 'grel chen rdo rje nyi ma'i snang ba las phyungs pa phyi dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs don skar rtsis kyi gnad cung zad 'phros don du smras pa/ 181mi pham rin 11 che/17 rtsom pa po ngo sgrod gnad bsdus/ 199

(dpar skrun gsal bshad/༄༅/ /rang re bod mi rnams mi yul du gyar nas mi lo lnga bcu tham pa 'khor ba'i dus dran srung brtsi zhu slad bod kyi dpe mdzod khang la las 'char mang the zhig yod cing / de dag gi khongs su rig gzhung nyams zhib dang bod yig dpar skrun sde tshan nas da lam dmigs su bkar nas rgya che'i mang 35gas kyi khe phan 91 nar bsams te dpe deb mi nyung ba zhig 'don 'char yod/ sman rtsis gnyis gar byang chub pa'i na gcadan snyu ma pa 11leg pa balha/da nams rin chen lags kyis so/ mang nyams zhib bgyis 'bras/ bod kyi srol rgyun sman rtsis rig pa'i dpyad yig mu tig phreng mdzes stod cha dang / smad cha/ 'di ga bod kyi dpe mdzod khang la dpar skrun zhu slad 'bul 'thus byung bar/ 'di nas rtsom pa por bsngags brjod tshad med dang / 'di nyid 'byung 'gyur na gachodan gzhan rnams la yang mig dpe bzang cad zhig tu 'gyur bar re/'di ga'i spyi khyab 'gan 'dzin dge bshes lhag the ra masnu ga gi lam lho na cadag 'byung 'gyur 'di nas dpar skrun rnams shākya thub pa'i deb phreng dang / skad yig deb phreng / nang chos deb phreng / rnam thar deb phreng / lo rgyus deb phreng / sna phyogs deb phreng bcas su 'char 'god bzhin dpar skrun zhu 'char yod cing / da lam gyi sman rtsis rig pa'i dpyad yig khag gnyis sna snu gas deb phreng dang cad dang gnyis pa'i nang du baspo da yodad/

57 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig ༷tshogs bsdus bzhugs so///bzhugs sgar bod kyi dpe malhu da khang ni/ 7bo/nga sa 7skyabs macadan chen po'i bla med kyi dbo ngas gzhi las grub cing / phyi 'o/ 1971 nas da bar chos rig gi gsung rab ji snyed cig dpar du bskrun yod cing / nye ba'i char la mtshon na nang bstan gsung 'gyur gyi zab spyong dang / tshan rig dang nang chos kyi 'brel ba'i steng nyams zhib dang bod 'gyur/ gsung chos 'dzin grwa 'phar ma/ bod rig pa'i zab phyu nga bcas ni las gzhi gsar gdodad kyi dpe mtshon tsam yin/ las gzhi de dag thams cad/ nga tsho'i 'gan 'dzin dge bshes lhag 〉ter maspyodag gi thad /ra gzigs 〉teg cesag las thosan sgrub bzhin pa lags 11/bod kyi dpe mdzod khang gi rig gzhung nyams zhib dang bod yig dpar skrun sde tshan nas 2009 zla 7 tshes 21 nyin/

༄༅༅/ /7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po'i sku bcar bla sman blo bzang dbang rgyal mchog gi mdzad 'phrin gnad bsdus brjod pa skal ldan bu slob dgyes pa'i masnu da sprin/ko༅༅/ /7rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu'i nye gnas stsodab ma/ sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen wa'i sku bcar sman pa chod bzang dbang rgyal mchog ni malnga mkhar rgyal wa'i rigs rgyud las mched pa yum tshe ring tsho dpal mo dang / yab phur bu tshe ring gnyis kyi sras su bod rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa lug (ye 'o/ 1919)'o/ra bod yul dbus lto kha 'atre ngas rgyas gter chen steng ri gdong brag ces pa'i sa'i gzhi mar sku 'khrungs/ yab yum gnyis wa'i thugs sras kyi snga ma yin stabs/ mche'i snying dang gces pa'i mig 'bras lta bur chung bsrings/de yang byis pa'i gnas skabs rtsed mo rtse shes tsam na 'dam bag gis gtor ma dang / zhal zas kyi 'dra gzugs bzo ba gnang ste zhabs brtan gyi tshul du 'alnga na pa 'don tshul byed pa dang / skabs rer sra rdor ri mo 'dra min bris te dbu 'khor ba 1/gas rang mnyam rtse cadags gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i bya lugs mdzad pa yin/ lhag par rām snga ma'i skabs tsam na su zhig gis kyang khrodab mkhan med par yig drug bris mar dpe gzigs kyis sa dang rdo bar ma ṇi yig drug dag gzab shar ris su mi nor bar dag par bri thub pa sku gas spyodan bonams bag chags bzang cad lhan skyes tsan dan

2 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig tso gas bsdus bzhugs sku //sdong po'i dri bzang bzhin 'grogs par snang / dgung lo bcu gsum la son pa chu sprel (ye 'o/ 1932 )'o/ra mchos snu ro/na grub dpa' thodas phyag btab pa'i gzhis dacadan 'chu ngas rgyas bkra shis bde chen daskra/na du rab tu byung la/ sku zhang rgyal mtshan chos dar skru ga gi slo ba dadze na du bsten te yi ge 'bri klog dag par bslabs/ de skabs dbothon pa'i lha rjes nyam thag nad pa du mar brtag dpyad kyis ga11la sman gnang ba yang yang gzigs pa de lta'i gzhan phan don gnyer gyi mdzad spyod la yid smon chen po skyes pa'i rkyen byas/ gso rig sbyong 'dod kyi thugs bskyed sa bon bzang wa'i myu gu macadan du mdzad/ dgon par bzhugs ring gi dus yun mi 'o/ gnyis lhag gi nang / dgon pa'i chosags 'dodan skyabs 'acad sems bskyed dang / sman bla'i maro/ cor+shag rgyas pa yid bzhin dbang rgyal/ khyodal snu ga spyodan lam rnam brgyad/ gdugs sher seng gsum la sku/gas pa 'don chos kyi dpe cha khag thugs 'dzin gnang /me byi (ye 'o/ 1936)'o/ra dathodan pa nas ched du bdams gses gnang ba'i grwa gzhon bcu gsum yod pa las sman rtsis khang du sman pa sbyong bar rtse btog gdams gses ched/ 7rgyal dbang dge 'dun rgya mchong sku ngo mas phyag bahwa gnang ba'i dpal ldan lha mo'i sku'i rten drung du lha mo'i 'phrin skul sems nyid ma grangs them rdzon sku nga gis zan brtag bsgril ba las sku nyid sman pa sbyong bar phebs dathodas pa'i lung bstan byung / de rjes da〉ten pa'i sman pa sku zhabs rgyal mtshan dbang 'dus lags la cadab stodan zhu gin gasku rig rgyud bzhi las/ margyud dang / bshad rgyud/ phyi ma rgyud bcas chod 'dzin gnang macad tshugs pas dus yun zla grangs 'ga' shas nang rgyud gsum cha tshang thugs 'dzin gnang thub pa byung / lha ldan sman rtsis khang du phebs khar gza' skar 'phrod sgror dge ba'i nyin zhig sku zhang rgyal mtshan chos dar

bla sman blo bzang dbang rgyal mchog gi rnam thar — 3lags kyi gzim shag tu sman rtsis cadab grwar tshud pa'i rten 'brel gyi bya lha chung chung zhig gnang / de skabs zhang zhang sngo mas nyid la shis gso'i mjal dar cadan bzhin ma cadangs par sman rtsis khang du cadab mthar sku na rjes bkras khang spyi khyab mkhan wa'i sku tshab 7rgyal ba'i bla sman pa bya thub pa'i sgyu na lam sku da/ ces 'byung 'gyur macadan par mkhyen pa lta bu'i ya mtshan gyi gtam/ sku nyid nas da lta la thug yang yang rjes su dran par gnang ba 'di bo gleng bar grags/shing sprel (ye so/ 1944)'o/ra 'acadangs rgyas bkra shis 6)sa gling las cadan te lha sa sman rtsis 'gro phan gling du dngos su gso rig slob gnyer gnang bar phebs/cadag mar dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhyen rab cadar bu mchodag zhal mjal ba'i skabs gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i gzigs snang lta bu'i smra mi shes pa'i dga' ba dang / yang dam pa nyid sku sha 'byor ba dang gzi mdangs bkra bas cung zad 'jigs yer ba ste zhed dga'i snang ba cig car de ma nyid du yid ngor 'char gsungs/sman rtsis dge ba'i bshes gnyen bla sman mkhyen rab nor bu dang / sku bcar bla sman sku gachodan thub bstan lhun grub lags zhal mjal ba'i nyin der/ dam pa de gnyis kyi sku drung du rgyud gsum dang chodas spyod dpe cha thugs 'dzin gnang garnams sgra dag gsal gsum lnga ga rgyugs 'bul zhus par ma zad/ stsodab da1—na mkhyen rab nor bu'i bka' bzhin phyi nyin cadab mang tshogs pa'i gral du'ang rgyud gsum dang chos ྅7da dag rgyugs 'bul legs par zhus pas cadab dasngo na bgres gcadan gnyis wa sa bsngags brjod dang sman rtsis slob ma yongs kyis dga' bsu thob/sman rtsis khang du stsodab zhugs rjes rtsis dge byams pa snu sa grags drung nas yig gzugs sbyong rgyu dang / dag yig sum rtags sku gas thun mong brda sprod rig pa'i

/ e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs sku //rmang gzhi'i shes bya rnams la slob khyodang hur thag gnang ba dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhyen rab nor bu mchog gi spyan snga nas sman gzhung rgyud bzhi dang / de'i 'grel pa baiḍūr+ya sngon po/ mes wa'i zhal lung / lhan thabs/ lus thig sman sbyor shel phreng lha/gas kyi dka' gnad dang / gtar bsregs las lnga'i dpyad rnams kyang lag len dmar khrid du gsan rjodang gnang / gzhan yang lo ltar dbyar dus slob ma spyi byings ltar ri mthor sngo sman ngos 'dzin dang sman rgyu 'thu sgrub la phebs pa dang / dgun dus sman rjodar khang du sman brdung ba dang ril bu sgril ba 1/gas kyi phyag las nang zhugs te bdud rtsi sman gyi rigs la ngos 'dzin thugs zhib dang sman sbyor gyi lag len bcas pa sbyong bar mdzad do/sku nyid rgyun du dge ba'i bshes gnyen mcho)ga la dad gus che ba dang / lhag par slob da5/na gyi zhabs do/ga sgrub rgyu sogs ldokhyo/ba ma gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i hur po dngan dag snang che bsku/da par gzigasate shing bya (ye so/ 1945)lo nas bzung slob dpon mkhyen rab nor bus gzim shag tu ched 'gug gis gzim chung du gtsang sbra bya rgyu dang/ kham sdong dang/ me dodag ldum rur chu rgyag rgyu sogs kyi phyag las mngags bya gnang bzhenasku/da/slob dpon gyi gzimachung du slobs rjes gzimachung phyi nang kun tu phyag dar gnang rgyu dang mchod pa phul rgyu/ khamasdong dang me tog ldumarwar g.yog cha bya rgyu/ de bden lho ba dasngo na gyi sku gam du bcar ba'i gzhung zhabs che drag khag la brtag dpyad gnang rgyu dang / gasku/'a/sman rjodar rgyu lha/gas bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i mchod pas spyodab dpon mnyes par byas/de skabasashin par slobagaspyi ltar sman rtsisagazhung lugasagatso gyur bshosaspringasadanganalam gathe rnam gsum/ byang chub lam sgron/ rjomad 'jug sku/gas la thos bsam gnang

bla sman blo bzang dbang rgyal mchog gi rnam thar 5ba phud/ dbo nga snga nam shar gzim chung du stsodab dasngo na gyi drung nas nang chodas dang rtsis rig dkar nag gi gzhung lugs la gsan ྅7nga gnang / de la gtsug lag rtsis rig thad/ 'byung rtsis man ngag zla zer le'u bdun ga'i khrid lung dang / skar rtsis sngon 'gro/ lnga pa 'phrod sogs rmang gzhi'i shes bya spyi dang / khyad par rigs ldan snying thig mgazhir thog le tho'i sbyor ba'i rtsis phran cha lag ma tshang ba med pa lto bras rtsis pa ye shes bstan pa dang mnyam du khyodab dpon drung nas gsan bzhes kyis le tho'i gza' lnga/ lnga bsdus kyi ri mo'i phyag len dngos nang zhugs te ye bstan dang lhan du le 1/ 'don spel yang gnang / gzhan yang / mtshan mo nam mkha' dwangs pa'i skabs dang bstun nas dge ba'i bshes gnyen masnumag gi drung du nam mkha'i gza' skar dang / gzang phyir ldog gi ngos 'dzin gsal nges dang / lo ltar nyi zla 'dzin tshul sogs la brtag zhib kyis dge sdig 'bras bu ji yong la dpyad pa gnang ba sogs dngos mthong rig pa'i bdud rtsi mngar mor thugs rtse gcig tu gzhol bar mdzad/lhag par de skabs dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhyen rab nor bus ngos kyi ci bsam pa der khyod kyi gzugs slebs kyi 'dug ces yang yang gsungs la phyi nang gi las snga na ga'/ che khag kyang nyid la yid ches blos 'gel gnang bzhin sku da/ bla sman pa mchodag thugs sems bzang po sku/da pas ma 'ongs 'thob dan rgya cher nus par dbo ngas te | dge ba'i bshes gnyen dam pa des bod kyi thun min gso rig gzhung las mig 'byed gsal byed rgyud pa'i phyag len dag ched du lag len dmar khrid gnang ba'ang sku nyid kyi mdzad rnam rgyas pa las mig 'byed slob sbyong gnang ba'i skor las 'o/gas par nges/ ye 'o/ 1959 lor rgya nag srid gzhung gis bod la btsan 'dzul

6 4 pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig khyedags bsdus bzhugs so/(gyis bod kyi thun min chos dang rig gzhung khag gtor bshig btang ba'i steng / bod dbus gzhung dang 'brel ba yod pa'i las byed pho snu che chung kun 'dzin bzung gis mnar gcod gtong mgo tshugs/ de'i tshe bla sman blo bzang dbang rgyal yang bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi sman pa yin par brnyas te lnga ga mar lha sa snga na sna da dang /de rjes chodar gling / ma17 snu rags bcas la rim pas bkag nyar byas/lcags byi (ye 'o/ 1960)so/ra rgya dmar srid dbang tshogs pas nag nyes 'dri zhib ces pa'i gasku thabs la kha g.yar te nyes pa sku/ bdun dus bkag bathergan 'jug dang / 'o/ gsum mkhar dbang gtsang 'phrog gi khrims thag bcad/ de rjes rim pas 'phan po dang / grwa phyi btson khang / nor gling / sna dkar rtse bcas so sor ngal rtsol bsgyur bkod la khrid de lus khams la bzod par dka' ba'i ngal ba cadang dbo sa byung mo da/ lhag par (ye so/ 1961 1962)bar lo gcig ring lho kha bsam yas su ngal rtsol bsgyur bkod du khrid par sku nyid dang btson grogs lhan rgyas la dmyal ba mi yul du 'phos pa lta bu'i sdug bsngal myong dbo sa byung ba ma zad/ btson bo gas du ma dka' dub dang bkres pas gdung ba'i mnar gcod 'og 'das bo ngas su gyur/ de la btson grogs rnams bkres ltogs kyi 'jigs pa las skyob ched phyi rol du skyes pa'i bza' rung ba'i sngo rigs ngo sprod dang / skabs mtshams zas spyodad spang blang ji 'dra dgos pa'i lam stodan gnang bar ma zad/ lhag par gzhan gces 'dzin gyi blos nyid kyi zas skal las cha gnyis lhag chad med btson grogs nad pa dag gi lus khams gso phyir 'bul gnang mdzad de/ rang nyid sngo tshod dang rta ༷/nga shi ba'i rus khu sku/gas la brten te 'a〉rga thabs mdzad pa sogs bzhan phan byang chub kyi sems pa dkar wa'i gzi byin yal ba med par lhan du bkra bar byas so//

bla sman blo bzang dbang rgyal mchog gi rnam thar 7chu stag (ye lo 1962)lor ngal rtsol bsgyur bcos ched bskyar du grwa phyi bathe na khang du khrid/ de skabs dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen sngo mkhyen rab cadar bu mchodag gi thugs rje'i gzigs pa chen 1rware bka' drin la brten nas grwa phyir sman pa'i phyag las nang bzhugs thub pa byung /chu yos/ ye lo 1963 nas grwa phyi dang / 'phan dze / bo nga sngo / cadabo/ spra spyod bcas sku sku ra sman pa'i phyag las gnang / sa der phyi lugs rgya rigs sman pa tshos nang chos dang 'brel ba'i bod kyi sman gzhung ni rmongs dad kyi dregs pas bcings pa'i gzhung lugs rnying pa zhig red ces khyad gsod dang mthong chung dma' 'bebs shugs che byas/ lhag par bla sman pa nyid rgya'i sman pa dang mnyam du phyag las gnang dgos stabs rgya rigs sman pa 'ga' zhig gis phrag dog dang 'gran sems kyi ngan tshig sna dgu gleng ste sku nyid la thugs bsun tshad med bzos/ 'on te bla sman pa mchodag nas de skabs ྅ped kyi sku la rgyun brtag thabs kyi rig par brten nas nad gzhi brtag dpyad kyis bcos thabs gnang bar nad pa mang sngo zhig la phan bskyed gsal sngo byung bar ma zad/ rgya'i phyi lugs sman pas bcos thabs med ces kha dmar rang gar 'phangs te khyi bzhin dor ba'i nyam thag nad pa mang sngo ra bod sman gyi bcos thabs la brten nas zug rngu bde blags ngang zhi bar mdzad/de yang / gang gi mdzad pa'i snyan grags dang khyad 'phags kyi lag rtsal la bajo na khang las byed mtho gras du mas bsngags bcadad dang / yid ches lhag tu 'phel ba byung ba de'i mthus gzhan gyi co 'dri'i 'a ba gling ngan pa yang chu nang gi lbu ba bzhin rang yal du gyur/ ye lo 1966 1968 lor rig gnas gsar brje chen po zhes pa'i mun nag gi rlung 'tshub chen pos bod pa'i chos dang rig gzhung

ཿ e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//rtsagator dang / bod mi shes yon can rnams la rdung rdeg de bzhin bod pa'i thun min yul thodams gshis lugs la dgag bya byed pa sogs lnga da kyi srol rgyun rig gzhung yod do cog gtor bshig tu btang / bod kyi gso ba rig par mtshon na/rmongs dad dang rjes lus su brtse ba ma zad me tel dang btsag bu sogs zhi drag gtar bsregs kyi cha dpyad rigs ma1/nga tshad la mi ga1/da kyi lag char kha g.yar ba sogs kyis sman ba3 sa lag len bya thabs bral ba'i gnas su lhang / de'i tshe bla sman pa mchog nas phyi lugs rgya sman la slob rjodang gnang mgo tshugs/ de yang phyi lugs gso rig slob sbyong ched thog mar rgya'i skad yig la slob sbyong dang / de rjes rim pas sman khab rgyag thabs dang dpyad chas 'dra min gyis nad gzhi brtag thabs sogs/ rmang gzhi'i shes bya khag lag len dmar khrid kyi tshul du slob sbyong gnang /ye lo 1969 lo nas bzung rgya'i phyi lugs rigs gcig rkang 'dzin gyi sman pa mkhas pa dag las spyir btang gi gshag bathodas rigs dang / phyi lugs mig 'byed/ bud med kyi nad bcos sogs la nad thog zung 'brel gyi slob sbyong gnang bas ri nga por ma thogs par rgya'i phyi lugs spyir btang sman bcos la mkhas par gyur pa smodas ci/ bod rgya zung 'brel gyi nad bcos lag rtsal la rgya sman mkhas pa mang pos bsngags brjod dang bkur 'os su gyur/ de yang klu sgrub kyis/skyes bu bya ba gang yin gcig byas mthar phyin pas/ /sems 'phags 'gyur te mang po ci la dgos/ /zla ba rgyas pas sa steng gsal ba bzhin/ /skar ma mang wa'i cho gas kyis nus ma yin/ /

bla sman blo bzang dbang rgyal mchog gi rnam thar 9zhes gsungs pa bzhin gzhan phan byang chub kyi bsam pa bzang sngo/sa nyam thag nad pa du ma'i zug rngu bcil ba'i rnam dkar 'phrin las kyi mdzad spyod las phyi lugs rgya sman pa skar tshogs kyi ngang tshul dag las ma15na par 'phags pa khyod bsangs mkha' yi zla 'od dang gnyis su med pa lta bur gyur/ lhag par gang gis nad gso'i thabs kyi rig pa dang / lag rtsal la gong rim nas bsngags brjod dang 'brel don mthun gasku rig dge rgan chen mo zhes pa'i mtshan gnas kyi me lta ga phreng ba'ang gang gi spye gtsug tu sgron par mdzad do/ /lcags sprel (ye lo 1980)lor bod ljongs sa gnas yongs kyi sman pa mkhas pa rnams 'du 'dzoms kyis lha sa sman rtsis khang du bod kyi gasku rig kun btus zhes pa'i sman dpe phyo ma sgrig dang / lag len nyams myong cad sprodad ces pa'i thengs dang wa'i chodags chen nang zhugs/ de skabs sku nyid thodad rang skyodangs ljongs spyi bde las khungs kyi sman pa'i gatheḍa 'gan bzhes bzhin sku da la rgya gar gnas mjal du phebs thabs kyang gnang bzhin pa red/ chu phag (ye 'o/ 1983)'o /ra phyir bskyod rgya nag srid gzhung gi bka' 'kho la phyag 'khyer thob pa'i 'og rtsa che'i nang bstan gnas mjal dang / lhag par gangs can lha gcig 7bo nga sa sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen po'i zhal mjal ched rgya gar du phebs/de skabs 7rgyal dbang rin po che mjal bcar zhu ba'i snga phyir mnal lam du dpal mabo na bram ze'i sprul pa mi dkar gyi gzugs can lan 'ga' dre na te sku nyid rgya gar du bzhugs dgos pa'i brda ci rigs ston gnang mdzad yod pa'ang zhib pa mdzad rnam rgyas pa 'tsho byed rgan wa'i tshudang ba sna chosags baljagad pa'i gtam zhes pa las thegegs nus/

10 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyo gas bsdus bzhugs so//sngon gyi las smon bzang po'i mthu lha bas dang / 'di phyi'i bamo da nams sku ngas 'du'i 'bras bzang las gangs can lha gcig spyan ras gzigs dbang 7rgyal dbang rin po che sku sngo mas nyid spyi bla sman par bsko bzhag gnang bar ma zad/ rang gzhung sman rtsis khang 'dir sman pa'i 'gan khur gyis gso rig bstan pa'i ched du zhabos zhu sgrub dathodas zhes pa'i bka' cadab gser gyi gcod pan gang gi ba1/da nams bag skal du bstsal/7rgyal ba'i bka' dgongs sgrub phyir dang / dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhyen rab nor bu mchog gi rnam thar bzang wa 3sa su skyong ched 7rgyal mchog sku phreng bcu bzhi pa chen sngo/sa phyag btab pa'i 'phags yul dha sa sman rtsis 'gro phan gling du sman pa'i phyag las gnang ste ji srid nam 'a66) bar bka' bzhin sgrub pa'i ma6)da pas rgyal ba mnyes par zhu rgyu'i thugs kyis dam bca' mdzad/bod rab byung bcu drug shing byi (ye lo 1984)lo nas bzung sman rtsis mkhas pa'i cho gas chung gi 〉rgags gzhon/ sman rtsis 'gro phan gling sgo bsten brtag dpyod khang dang / nad gasku khang gi thugs 'gan gtsor bzhes kyis nad par sman bcas gnang / bod kyi gso rig 'di nyid khyab spel dang / phyi nang gang zag nad pa du mar sman slad chodag mar rgya gar rgyal sa ldi li dang / ka li ka ta/ sbom sbe sku gas la skor bskyod dang / de rjes rim pas rgya gar lho phyogs su gnas pa'i gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum dang / gzhis khag la dgas/ sim la/ ma nā sī/ sngo rje gdan/ wā rā ṇa si sogs su 7bo nga sa mchodag gi chibs zhabs bla sman dang sbrags rgya gar dang / ngo nga pa/ la dgas/ de bzhin phyi rgyal gnas mjal dang / yul

bla sman blo bzang dbang rgyal mchog gi rnam thar 11'kho ra snyad 'cham pa sku gas tsha ba'i nad kyis gdung ba'i nyam thag 'bo ba mang ho ra zhi bsil sman dpyad kyi sprin bcud dal gyis dbab par mdzad/lhas par chu bya (ye 'o/ 1993)lor bla sman pa mchog nas sman rtsis slob grwa chen mo'i slob spyi'i thugs 'gan bzhes rjes/ sman rtsis slob grwa 'di bzhin yar rgyas sku nga slad ga1/ rig blo sa/sar ba rnams la sman pa'i slob grwa'i lam lugs bskyar bzo dang / slob ma rnams kyi sman rtsis shes bya'i go ltogs spel ched snga sor sasku ba rig pa dang 'brel ba'i gzhung lugs lag len mdzad phyogs kyi bka' stsodab dang / gzhan yang gso rig rgyud bzhi'i /snyung / tshe yi rig byed g.yu thog snying thig gi lung dang / cho ga dbyangs sogs sngar gyi rgyun srol bzang po mi nyams khrid skyong dang / rgyun du gso dpyad drang srong bstan srung spyi dang bye brag gso rig smon lam dang 'brel ba'i tshogs 'bul dang / slob ma rnams la bdud rtsi sngo'i sman sna ngo khyodad kyis legs nyes bya dga' gsol ras bong bu khrab rgyu sogs sngon sde srid rin po ches mdzad pa'i lugs bzang dge ba'i bshes gnyen mkhyen rab cadar bu mchog gis phyag len sal cher brtsi ba dag kyang nyid kyis sku la 'dzin nyams pa slar gso gnang bar ma zad/ slob ma rnams la gzhung bshad lag len zung du 'jug pa'i slob khrid stsol gnang mdzad pa'ang rgyun par gza' 'khor rer lho ba ma gsum bzhi re mnyam khrid kyis rtsa chu brtag thabs dang / nad ngos 'dzin lag len dmar khrid gnang ba sogs gzhal du med nga 'i drin gyis rnam/ bshad rgyud pa 'i sgo 'phar yangs po phye bar mdzad/chu sprel (ye lo 1992)lo mas bzung dbyin lan dang / ho lī na/ 'ja' man ni/ 'ja' pan/ pha ran si/ sus si lan/ u ru su/ sog po/ nor we/

12 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//sud ḍan sku/gas phyi'i rgyal khab khag la phebs te nyam thag nad pa du mar sman ba〉〉sa dang 'brel bod kyi gso ba rig pa gtsor gyur nang chos rig gzhung lo rgyus khag dang / bstan srid la sman pa'i las don sgrub cing / khyad par lag len dngos kyi myong bar brten nas 13da lugs gasku rig gi che ba 'don spel sgrub gsum gyi cad nas phyi gling don gnyen mkhan gyi blo dogs sel bar mdzad pa sogs brjod du med pa'i rnam dkar 'phrin las kyis gong bu rang cag gnas pa'i sa yi gling 'di'i rjes su 'ching bar byas pa 'di yang rab gnas me glang yan gyi mdzad rnam snying bsdus yin theṭa/ /smras pa/ rmad byung mdzad pa'i rnam thar chos dbyings mkhar/ /ring du bzhugs pa'i 'phrin las zla gzhon phung / /bdag blo dad pa'i lha yi rdzing ring pos/ /legs par drangs pa'i snang ba 'di ko mtshar/ /rnam dag dad pa'i 'dren byed kyis dben pas/ /rnam pa kun tu sman bla drang sku nga cho gas/ /rnam 'gyur lha skur gsal ba'i ngang tshul yang / /rnam dpyod blo rig dbang gis rags pa'i gzugs/ /gzhung lugs ze'u 'bru'i ro mchog mi myong bar/ /skam bshad tshig gi lo ma'i 'dab rtse ru/ /'phur rloms bdag 'dra'i gsar skyes rkang drug tshogs/ /zab mo'i bdud rtsi jo ba dus dka' snyam lha / /de phyir gzhung lugs lag len la mkhas shing // man ngag rgyud nas 'chodal ba'i mkhas pa'i gshis/ /mdzad pa'i snying por babo da 'dis nam du yang / /mi nub bskal brgya'i bar du brtam par sna ga/ //

༄tsho/ /gangs can bod kyi gso ba rig pa ngo sprod snying bsdus su bkod pa blo gsar dad pa'i 'jug ngogs/ /༄༅༅/ /na mo bhi ṣa dze/ thugs rjes 'gro ba'i don mdzad bcom ldan 'das//mtshan tsam cadas pas ngan 'gro'i sdug bsngal lha ba/ /dug gsum nad sel sangs rgyas sman gyi bla/ /be+eḍūr+ya yi 'od la phyag 'tshal lo/ /de la 'dir bod gangs can yul du sku/ngas su grags pa'i bcu phrag rig gnas kyi ya gyal gzhan rjes su 'dzin pa gasnu ba rig pa'i byung tshul sngo sprod gsal bsdus shig gling bar bya ba la/dang po/ cadad kyi gso rig gi thog ma'i byung tshul/gasku ba rig pa zhes pa'i tha snyad 'di ni 'thod ba nad can rnams nad las gasku ba ste khams sam 'du ba (nad rlung mkhris bad kun )mi lha mas pa bsal nas lha/mas par bya ba'i rig pa zhig la brjod pa yin/ 'di ni bod du 'gro ba mi'i rigs thog mar chags pa nas bzung mi rnams kyis rang gi lus khams bde bar 'tsho phyir/ nyin re'i 'asnu ba dngos nang lus la phan byed kyi thabs shes btsal ba dang 67gas mtshungs gcadad byed 'thodag pa'i thabs lam sna 35gas las btsal rnyed byung ba'i rig pa dag gasku ga 'jo ga byas pa las byung ba'i jo ga ma'i sman dpyad kyi rig pa zhig yin/ de yang gdod ma'i spyi tshogs skabs mi'i rigs kyis longs su spyod bya'i bza' btung ni shing 'bras dang rdzo rigs sogs phyi stod rang byung khor yug tu skyes pa'i kha zas rags pa kho na yin stabs/ de dag longs su spyod skabs pho ba'i me drod kyis 'ju ma thub par kho ga pa sbo ba dang dri ma 'gag pa sku gas gzugs gzhi mi bde ba ma zhu

11 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig tso gas bsdus bzhugs so//ba zhes pa'i nad 24ga gi sku da/ rjes su mi rnams kyis phyi sreg byed me zhes pa de bkol spyod kyi thabs shes rnyed pas bza' btung rjen pa dang / grang mo/ 'ju dka' ba'i rigs me la bsregs pa dang yang na btsos pa/ tha na drod gtong ba sogs kyi thabs shes brgyud de ma zhu ba'i nad rigs yong rgyur sngon 'gog thub par ma zad/chu grang bskol ba'i lag len shes rjes lus por drod bskyed pa dang / kha zas 'ju ba/ de min nad rigs gzhan dag la'ang phan pa yod par ra 'a'o/da byung bar brten sman gyi thog ma chu khol yin pa'ang ngal snyu la mi dmangs kyis nad rigs dang 'thab rtsod byas pa'i nang me bkol spyod kyi lag len kho na las byung ba'i don dngos kyi lo rgyus shig yin/ gzhan yang 'o ma dmo ga ste mar phyungs pa'i rig pa dang / chang bsnyal ba lha/gas kyi las thabs rig pa las rma kha la mar khu blugs nas khrag ga3)da pa dang sbangs ma'i 'jib byed pa sogs kyi nad greso thabs rig pa gsar pa ji snyed cig rnyed/ de ltar mi'i spyi tshogs kyi lo rgyus 'phel rim nang gso ba rig pa'i thog ma'i byung tshul lam myu gu lta bu ni mi rnams kyis thon skyed ngal rtsol byed pa'i lag len kho na yin/ lhag par thodad kyi rgyal wa'i chodag ma gnya' khri btsan sngo byon rjes bod de bzhin rgyal rabs kyi lo rgyus sku/da pa'i mi'i spyi tshogs su kha phyogs bsgyur mgo brtsams par ma zad/ mi'i rigs kyi thun mong gi rnam dadre da las/srog chags dang / gter rdzas rigs la nad gasku ba'i nus pa ji sku da shes rtogs byung la rim pas dngos rdzas de rigs dug sel dang sman sbyor bya thabs kyi lag len chung tsag rigs kyang shes rtogs thub pa byung sku da/ bod kyi rgyal rabs nyer brgyad pa lha tho jo ri gnyan btsan skabs khyim mtshes rgya gar rgyal bab nas sman pa mkhas pa dga' byed bi hrī dang / bi dga' lha ma dzes gnyis bod du phebs pa dang /

gso rig ngo sprod snying bsdus / 15sman pa de gnyis kyis dmangs kho da du nad ba3)sa gnang ba'i grags pa rim gyis rgyal wa'i snyan lam du gsan pas rgyal sngo sku nyid kyis sman pa gnyis 'o/ brang yum bu lha mkhar du spyan drangs te bsnyen bkur zhabs do/ga bsam gyis mi khyab par mdzad/ bod kyi yul du gso dpyad rig pa dang rigs 'dzin sman pa'i gdung rgyud spel ba'i 'dun pa mdzad de nyid kyi sras mo lha lcam yid kyi rol cha zhes pa sman pa bi sgyi dga' byed kyi btsun smadar phul/ rgyal wa'i sras mo lha lcam yid kyi ro/la cha dang rgya gar gyi sman pa dga' byed bi byi gnyis 'alo1gas pa las sras dung gi chodar jo ga can zhes pa 'khrungs/sras de nyid nar sku/na pa'i tshe gso dpyad sman gyi rig pa bslab pas mkhas par mkhyen pas rgyal wa'i sku tshe smad kyi bla sman dang / sras khri gnyan bzung btsan gyi sku che'i stod kyi bla sman mdzad/ sman pa 'di ni bod kyi lo rgyus thog gso byed sman pa dang rgyal wa'i bla sman thog ma yin zhing / rgyal lnga ga 'di nas bzung rim par rgyal sngo re'i sa/sku la sman zhabs zhu bla sman pa res mdzad par grags/de rjes dus rabs bdun pa yas mas chos rgyal gnam ri srong btsan gyi dus su rgya nag nas rtsis dang sman gyi gzhung lugs skor 'ga' zhig blangs pa bod kyi 'o/ rgyus nang gsal rung 'di'i tshe bod mi spyis bkol rung ba'i yig rigs shig med stabs rig pa'i gzhung lugs cha tshang can zhig dar med/ /gnyis pa/ gasdud ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs dang khyad par gzhung lugs chen po dpal ldan rgyud bzhi ji ltar byung ba'i lo rgyus gnad bsdus/1) gasku ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs zhes pa sngar nas dar ba'i gasku ba rig pa'i lag len gyi cadang ba dag rig pa'i gzhung lugs su gtan 'bebs kyis rnam bshad 'chad nyan gyi rgyun spel thub pa'i rig pa zhig la brjod pas/ 'di ni nges par bod

16 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//byings kyis bdodal thub pa'i brda cadad yig rigs kyis rmang gzhi byas pa'i bcadad bya'i don gyi ngo bo gsal ston nus pa'i rig pa'i gzhung lugs shig yin/ de yang bod rgyal khri rabs sku gsum pa codas rgyal sku nga btsan sgam wa drodan rjes rgyal po 'di nyid kyi bla na med pa'i dgongs gzhi'i mkhyen rlabs la brten nas cho rwardo zhing snying stobs can gyi chos blon thu mi sam bho ṭa rgya gar 'phags yul du yi ge cadab tu mngags/thon mis ngal ba du ma khyad du bsad de rgya gar du phebs shing / sgra rig pa'i gzhung lugs ji snyed la gsan bsam rgya cher gnang ste cadad yig ka mad sum cu gsar bzo mdzad pa tsam ma zad/ yi ge la brten pa'i ming tshig brjod pa sogs kyi lung gzhi brda spyod rig pa'i gzhung lugs tshad thub dar 'phel gnang / brda sprod yig rigs gsar bzo gtan 'bebs mdzad pa des bod mi rigs kyi rig gnas spyi dang sgos su gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs 'phel rgyas 'gro rgyur rin thang bral ba'i rmang gzhi gtod yod/ gso rtsis rig pa'i gzhung lugs gcig pur mtshon na dus 'dir rgya nag nas thodang ma thang tha'i dzung gi sras mo rgya bza' 'un shing kong ngo chodas rgyal srong btsan gyi btsun mor phebs pa dang / rgya nag nas gso rtsis rig pa'i gzhung lugs mang dag cig bsnams yod pa de dag rgya bod lo tsā ba rnams kyis bod rang lugs kyi skad du bsgyur/ lhag par thodad kyi sman pa mkhas pa mang po zhig gis rang rang gi rnam dpyod myong goms las thon pa'i gso ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs kyang ji snyed cig brtsams yod/dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang cadad kyi rgyal rabs sku bdun pa chodas rgyal mes ag tshom mam khri lde gtsug brtan gyis bod kyi gso rig dar rgyas yong rgyur thugs dgongs bzhes nas rgya nag dang / rgya gar/ bal yul/ kha che/ snga la 1/ sogs

gso rig ngo sprod snying bsdus / 17nas phyogs rigs kyi sman pa mkhas dgu bod la gdan drangs te yul lung sku mo'i sman dpyad lag rtsal brgyud spel sngar na ma grags pa zhig mdzad la/ de las kyang ches dar rgyas su gtong ba wa 3 khri lde gtsug ldan gyi sras chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan nyid yin/ chos rgyal 'di'i sku ring la bod kyi gso rig lo rgyus thog mdzad rjes che shos kyi sman pa rje btsun g.yu cadag rnying ma yodan tan mgon sngo byon/ rje btsun g.yu thog pa 'dis rang mes bod kyi gso ba rig pa tsam ma zad/ bal po dang / rgya nag rgya dkar/ li yul lha/gas khyim mtshes rgyal khab khag gi ga1/ ba rig pa'i gzhung lugs la lnga sa bsam rgya che gnang / khyad par rje btsun g.yu thog pa nyid kyi ches rlabs che sna sa kyi mdzad pa ni sngo da rang lugs kyi thun mo nga ma yin pa'i gso rig dpal ldan rgyud bzhi bsdu sgrig gis cha lag kha slong sdol ma mdzad de/ rnam bshad 'chad nyan gyi chu rgyun gangs sgyu ngas sa yi 'dzin mar dal gyis dbab par mdzad pa'i thugs rje bla na med pa de yin/2)bod rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i gso rig dpal ldan rgyud bzhi ji ltar byung tshul gnas bsdus/ de la 'dir bod kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i gso rig dpal ldan rgyud bzhi ji ltar dar ba dang / de nyid khungs gang la thug pa'i lo rgyus gnad bsdus shig gleng na/ rang lugs gso rig dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i khungs ni/ bdud rtsi snying sngo yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud nyid yin cing / gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud 'di nyid ྅ na pa 1stu no rang cag nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i ring lugs 'dzin pa sku da do thodag gi stodan pa mnyam med zas gtsang gi sras shākya thub pa nyid yin/de yang rje btsun g.yu thog pa nyid kyis gsungs las/ ston pa bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa nyid kyis chos kyi 'khor lo dang 10 gsungs pa'i dus su 'dul ba sman

18 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig tshudags bsdus bzhugs so//gyi lung bka' bstsal ba dang / gnyis pa'i dus su kun dga' wa la gcer mthong rig pa'i rgyud chen po le'u sum stong lnga brgya dang shel gyi me long gi rgyud le'u lnga bcu pa bka' bstsal/ chos kyi 'khe ra lo gsum pa'i dus mdo gser 'od dam pa las/ rig kyi lha mo byang chub yang dag par sdud pa la tshong dpon gyi bu khye'u chu 'bebs kyi nad rab tu zhi bar byed pa'i le'u bka' bstsal/ de'i tshe de'i dus na ston pa nyid sangs rgyas sman gyi blar sprul nas gso ba rig pa bdud rtsi snying po yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud bka' bstsal lta / /zhes gsungs la/ de lta'i sasang ba man ngag gi rgyud 'di bzhin ston pa las ji ltar brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ rje btsun g.yu thog gsar ma'i dngos chodab sum ston ye shes kyi gsungs las/ston pa sangs rgyas sman bla nas rim par drang srong rgyun shes dang / 'tsho byed gzhon nu/ mgon po klu sgrub/ dpal ldan pha khol/ kha che zla ba mngon dga'/ be+e ro tsa na/ khri srong lde btsan bcas rim par brgyud pa dang / chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan nas re zhig gter du sbas pa dang de nas grwa pa masngo na shes can gyis gter las phyungs te dbus pa dar grags dang 'cho byed dkon mchog skyubs la rim brgyud gnang zhing / 'cho byed dkon macesag skyabs las rje btsun g.yu lnga ga gsar mas gsan zhes gsal/ de la 'dir rje btsun g.yu thog rnying ma'i mdzad rnam las rgya gar ba'i slo ba dasngo na tsan dra thod mi dang bi ro tsa na las rje btsun nyid kyis gsan cing /de nas rim par rnying ma ba'i rgyud 'dzin lnga sogs sras brgyud rig 'dzin gsum dang bcu gsum pa gsar ma sku/na tan mthodan sngo bar brgyud la/ rje btsun g.yu cadag gsar ma sku/na tan mgon sngo sa gang gi yab dang khyad par 'asnu byed dkon mchog skyabs las dpal ldan rgyud bzhi snyu gas par gsan par grags/ rje btsun g.yu

gso rig ngo sprod snying bsdus / 19thog rnying ma'i mdzad pa gong du brjod pa ltar dang / skabs bab g.yu thog gsar ma sku/na tan mabonan po ni sku/ngas grags g.yu chodag rnying ma ba'i mi rabs bcu gsum par cadan/ bong ni rang mes gso rig rgyud bzhi yin tu dar rgyas su gdodang ba wa yin la deng rang lugs gso rig rgyud bzhi le'u brgya dang lnga bcu drug cha tshang bar bsdu ba po'am rtsom sgrig mdzad pa po yin pa ni gso rig lo rgyus smra ba po kun 'dod pa gcig mthun yin the///gsum pa/ bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i bzhung lugs dpal ldan rgyud bzhi nga sprad gnad bsdus/de yang bod kyi gso ba rig pa'i byung tshul spyi dang khyad par bod rang lugs thun mong ma yin pa'i gso rig dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i ston dang bstan par bcas pa'i 'o/ rgyus snying bsdus ngo sprod zhus zin te/ skabs bab bod kyi gso rig rgyud bzhi'i nang don ngo sprod mdor bsdus gleng ba la/ bod kyi gso ba rig pa ni/ nad kyis mnar ba'i lus can rnams nad las salha/ ba tsam ma zad/ mi na ba rnams bde bar ji ltar gnas nga/ dang / tshe rgos pa/ rnams ji ltar ring du bsrings bar bya ba'i thabs gtso bor stom pa'i sman dpyad rig pa'i gzhung lugs shig yin/ 'di la rgyud bzhi zhes pa'ang gretso che bzhung lugs chen po 'di nyid kyi brjod bya don gyi cha nas btags pa yin cing / sang zag blo rab 'bring tha gsum dang bcadad lnga na rgya che chung gi cha nas/ cadziba'i rgyud dang / bshad pa'i rgyud/ man ngag rgyud/ phyi ma rgyud ces rgyud bzhi ru nges pa yin/ca ba'i rgyud/ gang zag blo rab thi+o don du gsungs pa gasku ba rig pa thams cad kyi don sa bon gyi tshul du smos pa tshig nyung ngu'i sgo nas gso ris bi don rgya

20 na pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig khyodags bsdus bzhugs sku //chen po mdor bsdus te ston pa gso rig kun gyi rtsab yin pas rtsaba'i rgyud ces brjod/ 'di la le'u drug yod pa'ang / thog mar gleng gzhi lo rgyus zhes gso ba'i gzhung lugs chen po dpal ldan rgyud bzhi 'di nyid thog mar ston pa su zhig gis 'khor su zhig la dus nam gyi tshe gnas gang du tshul ji lta bu'i sgo nas bstan pa dang /bar du ji ltar brgyud pa bcas gso ba rig pa'i lo rgyus kyi khungs gsal bar bstan pa dang / de rjes gling gzhi'i le'u zhes pas gso ris rgyud bzhi'i nang don rnams dkar chag gi tshul du rnam grangs dbye ba'i lha nas bstan sku da/ de gnyis ni gso rig rgyud bzhi spyi yi thog ma'i mtshan ro/na dang gzhung dngos kyi yan lag lta bu yin yang / gasku rig rgyud kyi khungs dang dkar chag yin pas na rtsargyud khongs su bsdus pa dang / rtsargyud dasnga sa gzhir/ nad kyi rgyu rkyen dang 'byung tshul/ nad ngos 'dzin brtag thabs/ nad de gnyen pos ji ltar gso ba'i gso thabs zhes nad ji ltar bcos tshul gyi rig pa dag maro/ra bstan gnad bsdus kyi lam nas bstan pa yin no/ /bshad rgyud/ slo 'bring gi don du gsungs pa rtsaba'i rgyud du mdor bstan pa rnams gsal bar bshad pa dang / gsal ba rnams su ma tshang ba kha bskangs te bshad pa / cha mthun rnams kyang snga na nges shes bskyed de bshad pa/ khyad par gasku/ dpyad kyi jo/na thams cad rgyu mtshan bshad thabs kyi rig pa'i lhu/ nas gtan la 'beb pas na bshad pa'i rgyud ces brjod de/ 'di la le'u so gcig yod pa'ang gtso bo gso bya / gso byed/ ji ltar gso ba/ gso ba po bcas rnam pa bzhir bsdus te bstan yod/ de las/dang po gso bya zhes par lus dang nad gnyis su dbye ste bstan pa'ang / lus la/ chags tshul dang / 'dra dpe/ gnas lugs/ mtshan nyid/ las dang dbye ba/

gso rig ngo sprod snying bsdus / 21'jig ltas bcas le'u bdun dang / nad la rgyu dang / rkyen/ 'jug tshul/ mtshan nyid/ dbye ba bcas le'u lnga ste bsdoms pas le'u bcu gcigaganyis pa gasku byed gnyen sngo la zas ྅ da sman dpyad bzhi sku da pa las/ spyodad lam la rgyun spyod dang / dus spyod/ gnas skabs spyod pa bcas le'u gsum dang /zas la zas kyi tshul shes par bya ba dang / zas bsdam pa/ kha zas srung ba dang zas tshod ran par bza' ba bcas le'u gsum/ sman la ro dang zhu rjes/ sman gyi nus pa / sman gyi sde tshan dang sbyar thabs bstan pa bcas le'u gsum/ dpyad la gnyen po cha byad bstan pa'i le'u gcig bcas khyon le'u bcu/gsum pa nad de gnyen sngo sa ji ltar gasku ba la/ mi na ba gnas shing ring du 'tsho ba dang / nad ngos 'dzin brtag thabs dang / gso tshul/ gso thabs bcas kyi dbye ba bstan pa las/ mi na ba bde bar gnas pa'i thabs bstan pa la le'u gcig dang / brtag thabs la nyes pa dngos kyi brtag pa dang / ngan gasku skyodan gyi brtag pa / spang blang mu bzhi'i brtag pa bcas le'u gsum/ ga1/ tshul la gasku tshul spyi dang khyad par bcos tshul rgyas par bshad pa la le'u re dang / gso thabs gnyis bstan pa dang gso thabs dngos la le'u re bcas khyon le'u brgyad bstan/ bzhi pa gso ba po sman par le'u gcig bcas khyon le'u sum cu yod do/ /man rgyud/ blo tha ma'i don du gsungs pa de yang nad re la rgyu rkyen dbye ba rtags dang bcos thabs man ngag lag len dmar khrid kyi lha nas rgyas par bshad pa man ngag gi rgyud/ 'di la le'u dgu bcu go gnyis yod/phyi rgyud/ blo dman pa rnams kyi don du gsungs pa lag len du blang bde ba don gsal la gnad du 'dril ba'i tshul du gtan la 'bebs pa phyi ma'i rgyud/ 'di

22 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//la le'u nyi shu rtsalnga yod pa 'di'i nang / rtsadang dri chu'i brtag thabs rgyas pri ra bsngan sku da par ma zad/ sman rjodar dang / gtar bsregs sku gas dpyad kyi lag len dag rgyas par bstan yod snga / /gso rig rgyud rdzi nang don rnams snying por bsgril na/ 1 gso bya lus kyi rnam bshad dang da gso byed gnyen gro'i rnam bshad/ 'a ji ltar gso ba'i rnam bshad/ 4 gatsha/ ba ngo'i rnam bshad bcas bzhi ru 'dus pa yin/1 gso bya lus kyi rnam bshad ces pa zhe/ 'byung bzhi'i rdul gyis ma 'i mnga' du lus thog ma ra ji snye ra chags nga dang / bar du ji ltar gnas pa/ tha ma ji ltar 'jig tshul gyi rnam gzhag gsal bar bstan par ma zad/ 'byung ba 'khrug pa'i med ji ltar bskyed tshul dang nad de dag 'byung ba'i rkyen dang mtshan nyid/ nad lus la ji ltar 'jug tshul dang nad rigs kyi dbye ba ci tsam yod pa sku gas gsal bar ston pa'i rig pa zhis yin/na sa10 byed gnyen wa'i rnam babad ni/ nad gso bar byed pa'i gnyen po zas dang ྅ da lam sman dang dpyad bzhi'i phan gnod dbye ba gsal bar bshad pa'i rig pa zhig yin/zha ji ltar gso ba'i rnam bshad ces pa ni/ nad ji ltar gso ba la thog mar nad rigs brtag dpyad bya tshul gyi rig pa dang / nad ngos bzung ba dag ji lta bu'i tshul gyis gasku/ ba'i thabs ston pa'i rig pa zhig yin/4 gso ba ྅6) rnam bshad ni/ nad gso bar bya mkhan gyi sman pa'i kun spyod 'khyer so/ dang / sman pe sa nad par byams lha nga ji ltar bya thabs sogs nad gso ba wa'i sman pas spang blangs ji ltar bya rgyu'i rim pa gsal bar bstan pa zhig yi na

gso rig ngo sprod snying bsdus / pono/ /gso ba rig pa'i brjod don gang yang gong gsal rnam bcad bzhi wa'i nang ma 'dus pa med pas bod kyi gso ba rig par don gnyer can gyi blo gsar rnams nas thodang gsal gasnu rig gi byung tshul dang / 'dir gleng ba'i gasku rig rgyud bzhi'i snga na gnad snying bsdus dag mkhyen the gas thub na thun ce/nga ma yin pa'i snga/da kyi gasku rig gi snying po bsdus pa dpal ldan rgyud bzhi'i nang don mdo tsam rtogs rgyu dang rig pa 'di la 'jug lnge ga mi 'a17la ba'i dge mtshan lhag tu che'o/ /zhes pa'ang rab gnas lcags lug lor blo gsar bu rnams la sman phyir bris pa maṅga waṃ// //

༄༅༅/ /gso rtsis dgongs don 'dzam gling che chung gi rnam bshad la dpyad pa baiḍūr+ya'i rang mdangs zhes bya ba'o/ /༄yo/ /namo baiḍūr+ya bud+dha ya/ gang zhig bsnyen pas tshe rig bdud rtsi'i char//zol med snying rje'i phang las 'dzad med du/ /ris med phyogs kun dbab mdzad sman gyi bla/ /zhi gsal bde stong mkha' la rol de rmad/ /mtha' bral stong pa'i dus las phyi nang dngos/ /'gal med 'byung bzhi'i byed sngo sa gzhi gcig tu/ /bskrun pa'i rig lam kun khyab sman dang rtsis/ /ston mdzad yongs 'du'i ba'es gnyen tsismar rol/ /zab gsang man ngag chu gter klong rdol bas/ /spyi khog mun sel 'od dkar bcud du phyungs/ /e ma 'ode rnyi phra rags 'byung bo'i gshis/ / yang dag legs bshad rin chen mthong ba'i ma'e0ga /de yang gab dkrugs bcings 14gas man ngag bzhi'i/ /sbas don snying po ma sku ngas tshig tsam la/ /zhen pa'i blo chung rtog ge dbul ba'i gdung / /sel phyir legs bshad baiḍūr nor 'di gnyer//zhes skabs bang bswā da don dang 'tsham pa'i mchod tshig usmakhola'i phreng gis khyodan bsus te 'dir gleng bar bya ba ni/ bdud rtsi snying po/ yan lag brgyad pa gsang ba man ngag gi rgyud gnyis pa bshad pa sku'i rgyud kyi grub pa lus gnas bstan pa 'i le'u las/ 'dzam gling rang lus 'dom gang khru bzhi ste/ /zhes nga 'i rdo rje'i tshig 'a sa 'phros pa'i/ sbas don dasngo sa 'dzam gling che chung gi rnam bshad skor yin te/ dang po/ sngon 'gro spyi don r+bhe nang rten 'brel stodar rags tsam gleng ba/ gnyis pa/ phyi stod 'dzam gling che chung dang de'i tshad gzhal tshul dogs slong / gsum pa/ rgyud

26 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so// (dus 'khor )lugs snod kyi 'jig rten chags tshul dang de lugs tshad gzhal tshul gsal bsdus/ bzhi pa/ phyi nang mnyam par ji ltar sbyor tshul/ lnga pa/ 'dzam gling che chung gi mtha' dpyad pa/ drug pa/ lus gnas 'dir dmigs su 'dzam gling gi tshad gsungs ba'i dgos pa dang / 'dis gso ba rig pa'i lag len nang dgos khyad gang ldan yod bstan pas mjug bsdu'o/ /dang po/ spyi don phyi nang rten 'brel skor bshad pa/de yang / rgyal bas chos rnams kun gyi snying washe na cing 'brel 'byung du gsungs pa bzhin sems can spyi mthun las kyis grub pa'i sa dang skar khyim gyi go la ji snyed phan tshun rten 'brel ltos grub kyi tshul du gnas pa'ang / de kun spyi mthun las las skyes pa'i 'bras bu sa chu me rlung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gzhi gcig nang mnyam du chags par 'grel cing 'byung bzhi'i rdul phran de dag gi 'gyur ba sna tshogs la brten nas sa dang khyim gyi bo la rnams chags pa/ 'phel ba/ gud pa/ 'jig pa la sogs pa'i 'gyur ba skad cig mi sdod pa'i gnas lugs gsungs pa dang / khyad par sa dkyil 'dzam gling chen po 'di'i steng du chags pa'i 'gro ba mi sogs bcud kyi sems can kun kyang rigs mthun de las byung ba'i rgyu las kyis gtso byas 'bras bu 'byung 'dus kyi phung po grub cing de dag 'byung bzhi'i rdzas rdul phra rags kyi rkyen la brten nas chags pa/ skye ba/ gnas pa/ 'phel ba/ na ba/ gud pa/ shi ba la sogs phyi snod kyi 'gyur ba ltar gcig tu mi sdod pa yin/ bdag cag gi ston pa'i gsung gang nas kyang phyi nang dngos kun rten 'brel gyi tshul du 'byung lnga'i rdzas phra rags kyis grub par gsung bar ma zad/ skabs don sman rtsis rig pa'i gzhung lugs las kyang gab sbas dkrugs sogs man ngag gi lam du ma nas gnad ka ci

'dzam gling che chung gi rnam bshad / 27rigs bstan sku/da pa'ang / galha/ rig rgyud phyi ma las/ thabs dang thabs byung 'brel ba ci ste med/ /'gro ba'i lus 'di 'byung ba bzhi las grub/ /gasku bya'i nad kyang 'byung ba bzhi yis bskyed/ /gnyen wa'i sman yang 'byung bzhi'i ngo tho nyid/ /(1)ces dang / dus kyi 'khor lo nang nges pa'i le'u las/ sa dang chu me rlung dang rdo rje lha yi gzhu dang rlung rnams dang ni khyim gyi 'khor lo dang / /zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan lhan sngo gdengs can mi dang lha yi gnas dang 'khyodag sngo skar mar bcas 'pho ba zla ba dag dang ༷ gas dang nyin dang mtshan sdu/ tshes rnams mtha' dag lus kyi dbus su ni/ /rang rang yi gos shes bya rnam gsum khyab bdag bgrod pa rnal 'byor pa yis stong pa'i dbye bas so/ /(2)zhes dang / yang de nyid las/ phung po'i rten ni 'byung ba rnams su 'gyur te lus mchog dag la 'byung ba'i tshogs kyi cangarnams so/ /(3)zhes dang / de bzhin 'byung rtsis rig pa las/ phyi yi snod kyang 'byung ba lnga/ /nang gi phung khams 'byung ba lnga/ /don dang snod kyang 'byung ba lnga/ /(4)zhes lha/gas gsungs la phyi nang gnyis cen 'brel gyi tshul la/ gso rig las/ lus nad gnyen po bdag nyid gcig par 'brel/ /gnod bya gnod byed rten dang brten pa ra 'brel/ /gso bya gso byed bsku da nams las kyis 'brel/ /(5)zhes dang /dus 'kho ra las/ phyi nang sngo bo gcig par 'brel tshul sku gas spros pas mi langs mod/ gzhung lugs 'di rigs la dag snang dang slob gnyer tshul bzhin mi 'jug pa g.yam rgyugs bshad gros tsam la phyogs pacirngo skye bo la las go lo shes 61re tshul gyis yang dag rgi don rnams ring du dor ba dang / la las kha nang du gcus tsam yang mi byed par deng tshan tshan rig pa smra bas 'phrul mchodang bi rtsal rig sku gas las dpyad pa'i sa dang skar khyim go la'i rnam bshad dang / mi'i lus phung gi rdzas phra

23 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//rags kyi grub tshul sku gas la zhen cher byed par ma zad/ de dag sngar byung myong med pa'i rlabs chen gyi mdzad rjes la rtsi bzhin mdzub rtser bgrang gang thub byed/dper na/ tshan rig pas 'phrul chas rig pa'i lam nas brtag pa'i phyi'i nyi zla sgrib tshul kyi kha dmar 'di bzhin lha chen tshangs pa chen wa'i (theg shing ltar tshad mar bkur te blos brtag tsam yang me bzo ba dang / rang re'i mes po bo nga ma rnams kyis rtsis rig dang sgom stobs gnyis las bstan pa'i nyi zla 'dzin tshul gyi gzhung lugs 'di bzhin rnying khungs phal par brtsis te mchil bzhin dor la/ da dung rig pa 'di dang 'di 'dzin don gnyer can la 'phya ba'i smyo kha gnyid rkub kyi gtam smra ba mang du malnga nga bas/ rig pa 'di ni don du phri nang cen 'brel rtogs nga/'i yab mes mkhas dbang rnams kyis rgyal gsung tshad mar bzung ste dus yun mi lo brgya stong du ma'i nang grangs rtsis dang brtag thabs sgom lam bcas kyi rnam rig la brten te dpyad pa phra zhib mdzad yod par ma zad/ phyi nang rten 'brel gyi tshul las nyi zla 'dzin pa'i dus yun nang phyi snod kyi khor yug dang nang bcud 'gro ba'i lus khams su bde sdug gi 'gyur ba ji ltar 'gro ba dang dus gnad 'di bzung ste dge sdig gi blang dor ji ltar bya tshul nying dgos su bstan yod pa sogs ni phyi nang sen 'brel ltogs pa'i phyag rjes zab mo zhig yin pa/ 'di ni phyi nang gnyis rten 'brel gyi tshul du ji ltar grenas pa'i dpe mtshon tsam yin pas 'di la rgya'i tshan rig mkhas can dbyi kri sngogere yis/ nang pa sangs rgyas pas nyi zla gza' 'dzin gyi dus su ma ṇi 'ur 'don byed pa sogs dar zhing / phyi dus kyi 'khor ro'i rnam gzhag gsungs pa'i skabs nyi zla sgrib tshul gyi tshul phra zhib ma/dzad nas zhar la sgom stobs kyis phyi'i chos nyid mtha' dag nang sems kyis thag gcod thub par ma zad/ tshul de dag masngo na sum

'dzam gling che chung gi rnam bshad / 29du mchodang ba ngo mtshar las kyang ches ngo mtshar tshan rig las kyang ches tshan rig lags/(6) zhes dang / sangs rgyas pa'i gzhung gi dus kyi 'khor lo'i dbo ngas don mthar thug mdzad pa de mkhyen pa nyi zla'i 'od rlabs kyis macadang ba zhig las bshad phyogs tsam gtan nas min/ tshan rig pa su yin kyang rung tha na 'a24 bcas dus kyi 'khor lo'i rnam gzhag gi zur tsam khong du chud na yang glegs bam de snying gar mi bcangs zer na ngas rdo nga gdab par nus pa yin/(7)ces dbang med gsungs shor ba 'di rigs btang snyoms su mi 'jog par yang du bsam dgos 'dugagazhan yang gso rig rgyud kyi thog mar sman bla'i grong khyer gyi bkod pa dang /ri bo rnam bzhi'i khyad chos sogres phyi sdod khor yug gi rnam bshad sngon du bstan cing dngos bstan bshad pa'i rgyud du dmigs bkar phyi snod 'dzam gling dang nang lus sbyar tshul mdzad pa/ de bzhin rgyud tha ma phyi rgyud las phri dus kyi 'gyur ba dang bstun pa'i mkhams dang 'phar tshul sogs phyi nang rten 'brel gyi tshul du ji ltar grub pa dngos shugs ci rigs pa'i cad nas bstan yod pas/ nang mi'i lus khams kyi nad gasku bar 'dod pa'i 'tsho byed rnams kyis rab la byung na rigs mthun phyi stod kyi 'jig rten chags tshul dang / nyi zla gza' skar gyi bgrod pa brtsi tshul sogs la bslab dgos te/ phyi nang 'byung ba zung rten 'brel du gnas par ma zad/ nad kyi gnyen po mo drug rnams kyang phyi snod kyi 'byung ba 'ba' zhig la brten nas byung ba gong du lung drangs zin pa dang / 'dir yang rgyud kyi nang le las/ lus 'di la ni khams kyi snu gas su mtha' dag ro drug zos shing 'thung ba las kyang 'gyur ba ste/ /ro drug rnams kyang 'byung ba las te rab gsal nges par 'byung ba'i tshogs kyang nam mkha'i khams las sku// / 8)zhes gsungs pa'ang nang lus 46re sha khrag

30 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//la skusnags pa'i khams rnams ni mngar ba la sku/gas pa'i ro drug sngo jo sa pa'i dbang gis 'phel 'grib ci rigs par 'gyur la/ khams kyi 'phel 'grib de la ltos nas lus la bde sdug gi tshor ba myong ba ni/ gso rig las/ sa chu me sa chu dang rlung //me rlung sa rlung gnyis kyis ro drug bskyed/ /(9)ces gsungs pa 'di nyid dus 'khor ye shes le'u las/ lan tshwa sa dang mngar ba chu ru rab tu 'gyur zhing tsha ba me dang kha ba rlung yin te/ /skyur dang bska ba'i ro ni 'dres pa dag go/ /(10)zhes phra zhib tu bstan pa las rtogs par byacad/de yang / zhib tu na nang mi'i lus khams kyi nad ga1/ ba'i ro drug gi nad ni phyi stodad kyi chags tshul dang gnam gshis tsha grang sku gas 'byung bzhi'i 'gyur ba la bslab ste shes par bya dgos/ de lta'i phyi nang 'byung ba'i rten 'brel gyi gnad rtogs pas khams mi snodams par lha mas par bya 'dod pa'i 'tsho byed kyi las 'grub pa sgyu sa ci rten 'brel gyi gnad gzhan yang gcig shes kun grol gyi dper 'gyur rgyu gasnga na mi za ba ni dbang du 'dus pa rten 'brel gyi mthus so/ /kha cig de lta'i dgos khyad dang sgrub byed cha tsam yang ma mthong bar/ rgyud kyi maba'i nang bstan pa'i sman gyi grong khyer dang ri bo rnam bzhi'i bkod pa sogs smos pa 'di lha sgrung lta bu zhig las des gso thabs rig pa'i jo ga dathodas pa gang yang mi ldan snyam pa dang / yang kha cig sman gyi nus stobs dang 'byung khungs sogs cha tsam rtogs kyang de dag rten cing 'brel tshul gyi gnad gsal bar ma ho gas pas tsham chosam du lus pa dang / la las ni snyu ma rigs kyi nyams rtsal gcig pu mjo nga bas de ni rtsom pa sngo/sa phyis 'byung 'jug pa po rnams spro ba bskyed phyir bris pa'o ༄ra ba sogs rang 'dod 'chal gtam dang gzhan zer kha grags kho na smra ba 'di kun rang lugs thun min gyi rig pa'i gzhung

'dzam gling che chung gi rnam bshad / 31lugs la chod kha ma ༷ gas pa dang / gzhan gyi rig gzhung la lad snu/ che ba'i skyodan du mthong bas rang gzhan gnyis su mi the ba'i pags byi'u yi bya byed dag ring du dor ste phyi nang rten 'brel gyi chodas tshul la 'jug par gyis shig ces yang du gleng bar 'dod pa'i gtam gyis smra sgo phye bcod/ /smras pa/ rang sdudags 'dod pa'i zhen khog tsam min par/ /yang dag gzhung lugs zab mo'i tshig skyodar 'ode/ /dngos stobs dka' gnad kyis phongs mu lto bas/ /zol med 'char sgo rdab rdib ngag las drangs/ /gnyis pa/ phyi snod 'dzam gling che chung dang de' gzhal tshul gi dogasaslong bkod pa/de yang / bshad rgyud gnas lusas nad gzhi'i le'u las/ 'dzam gling rang lus 'dom gang khru bzhi ste / /zhes pa'i rgyud tshig tu/ phyi snod 'dzam gling che chung gi gle nga bslang ba tsam las tshad 'dicad zhes nges pa gsal bar ma gsungs pa'i sbas dodan 'di nyid bshad 'grel 'bum nag gsal sgron du/'dzam bu gling pa (11) zhes pa tsam las che chung gi dbye ba mi mdzad kyang mes zhal dang be+e ྅ na sogs dgongs 'grel phal cher 'dzam gling chung ngur bzhed 'dug pa/ de ltar na 'dzam gling chung ngu'i phyi yul gyi tshad ji ltar gzhal dbos pa dang / gzhal yul de nyid nang mi'i lus khams la ji ltar sbyar tshul thad ro/gas pa sku da de/ rgyud 'grel pa po'i bzhed pa dngos gang yin gsal bar mi rtogs pa'i phyir ro / /

32 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//1) gal te dus 'khor lugs bzhin gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas par 'dzam gling chen po dang / lho gling gcig pu la 'dzam gling chur ngur bzhed pa'i dgongs don ltar na/ nang rdo rje'i lus khru bzhi dang sbyar gzhi phyi yul gyi tshad dpag tshad 'bum bzhi ji ltar gzhal/2) gal te lho gling dbus ma'i lho'i rlung dkyil gyi mtha' nas sa dkyil nang mtha' bar dpag tshad 'bum gnyis dang sa dkyil nas steng ri rab dpag tshad 'bum gcig de steng snang ba yid gzugs kyis phye ba'i dpag tshad 'bum gcig bcas khyon dpag tshad 'bum bzhi la phyi'i 'jig rten nam 'dzam gling mtho dma'i tshad du bzhed pa ltar byed na/ gling gzhan gyi mi'i lus por khru bzhi ldan min la da dung the tshom chod dka' bas/ 'di'i gnad ka ji ltar sel 'dod/gsum pa/ rgyud (dus 'khor )lugs cadad kyi 'jig rten chags tshul dang de lugs tshad gzhal tshul gsal bsdus/dang 14/ phyi snod kyi babo da pa chags tshul bshad pa la/spyir phyi nang snod bcud chags 'jig gi rgyu gtso cad 'gro ba'i las kho na yin par 'dod de/ phal po che las/ ji ltar sa bon khyad par gyis/ /'bras bu sna tshogs snang ba ltar/ /de bzhin las kyi khyad par gyis/ /sems can rnams dang zhing 'byung ngo / /zhes dang / dbu ma 'jug pa las/ sems nyid kyi ni sems can 'jig rten dang / /khyodad kyi 'jig rten sna tshogs shin tu 'god/ /'gro ba ma lus las las skye bar gsung / /zhes gsungs la/ khyad par phyi stod kyi 'jig rten 'di nyid sems can spyi mthun las kyi rnam smin lha bas kyis dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi

'dzam gling che chung gi rnam bshad / 33par gsungs pa ni dus kyi 'khor lo'i dgongs pa khyad par can yin pas/ de lta'i khyodad kyi 'jig rten chags pa'i rgyu gang yin masnga tsam smras pa sngon du song nas skabs su ji ltar chags pa 'i tshul gyi rim pa bshad pa la/ rgyud las/ dus kyi rdo nga pa rnams las rlung dang 'bar byed chu dang 'dzin ma gling dang ri bo rgya mtsho dang //(13)zhes gsungs pa ltar chags pa'i 'jig rten gyi bams de snyed du rang gi las kyi 'bras bu la longs ྅ da pa'i rgyur 'gyur ba'i sems can gang yin pa de rnams kyi spyi mthun las kyis rten snod bcud kyi 'jig rten gyi khams dang rjes su mthun pa'i 'od gsal rgyu rgyud gzhoms med 'od zer drug dang ldan par gsungs so//de yang rgyud las/ gasku na gyi yan lag tu ni dkar sngo 'bar ba 'gro ba'i bdud rtsi'i cha dang g.yas su dmar wa'i mdog /ces dang / rgyab tu ser po yang ni skar ma lha gzhu sa ste de ni rnam bzhi gnyis kyi dbye bas so/ /sku ga ces bya ba'i gcig pu'i rlung ni rnam bcur 'gyur te spyi bo rtsab dag dang mdun du'o/ /(13)zhes shar du nag po 'bar ba/ ltor dmar po/ byang du dkar po/ nub ser po/ steng ljang gu/ 'og tu sngon po 'bar ba rnams dang / de ltar kun gzhi rgyu rgyud kyi steng gi 'od ljang las srog 'dzin gyi rlung dang / 'og gi 'od zer sngon po las thur sel gyi rlung ste sku ga thur gyi rlung gnyis grub pa dang / de bzhin shar gyi 'od las/ mnyam gnas dang / khyab byed/ klu/ rus sbal/ rtsangs pa/ lhas byin zhes pa'i phra ba'i rlung bdun skyes shing / rgyu rgyud dang lhan gcig pa'i nor las rgyal ba'i rlung ste las rlung bcu grub par 'dod/ de lta'i las rlung bcu po la'ang rang rang byed las mi 'dra ba'i chas/ 'dzin srubs dbyibs byed gsum du 'dus te/ khyab byed dang lhas byin gnyis chu'i khams yin pas/ khams lnga'i rdul phra rab bsil bur gnas

31 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//pa dbang wa'i spyod yul du ma gyur pa stong rdul lam mkha' rdul zhes ming gis snyad pa de rnams gong bur bsdus par byed cing / klu dang nor rgyal gyi rlung gnyis sa khams yin pas bsdus pa de rnams sra bar byed/ khyab byed dang lhas byin rlung gnyis 'dzin byed (sa khams)kyi rlung yin pas gong gi rlung rnams gnas gzhan du mi galta nga bar 'dzin par byed/ gyen rgyu dang rtsangs pa gnyis me khams kyi rlung yin pas bzung ba de dag bsrubs pa'i tshul gyis smin par byed/ mnyam gnas dang rus sbal gnyis rlung khams kyi rlung yin pas bsrubs te smin pa de dag dkyil 'khor dang ri gling la sogs pa de dang de'i gnas su bskyod cing 'jog pa'i tshul gyis dbyibs kyi bya ba byed pas dbyibs byed kyi rlung du 'dod la/ srog 'dzin dang thur sel nam mkha'i khams kyi rlung gnyis 14sa de dag thams cad kyi grogs byas te 'phel grib kyi go skabs sbyin par byed do/ /de ltar phra ba'i rlung 'di dag gtso bor nam mkha'i rlung gis rdul phra rab rnams bsdus te 'dab 'byar du 'gyur bas yang zhing g.yo ba'i rlung gi dkyil khor dbyibs zlum po thad /ra dpag tshad 'bum phrag bzhi dang / 'khor yug 'bum bcu gnyis/mthug rngams stong phrag lnga bcu yod pa tha ma gyen du langs pa zhig grub pa ni nam mkha' stong pa'i dbyings las grub pa'i rlung rdul gyi dkyil 'khor zhes bya ba yin te 'di nyid thog mar stong pa'i dbyings las grub par bshad do/ /de rjes rlung dkyil gyi lha ra ba'i nang rlung rdul mkha' la 'khrugs pas glog 'byung ba ltar lho'i 'od dmar po las me'i rdul phra rab rnams 'byar ba las rlung dang ldan pa'i slog 'khrig pa lta bu'i me'i dkyil 'khor thad dkar dpag tshad 'bum phrag gsum dang / 'khor yug 'bum dgu mthug rngams stong phrag lnga bcu yod pa'i me rdul

'dzam gling che chung gi rnam bshad / 35gyi dkyil 'khor chen po zhig grub/ de rjes des skyor ba'i nang byang gi 'od zer dkar po las chu rdul 'byar ba las rlung me dang ldan pa'i sprin byung ba las char babs pa ltar/ chu'i dkyil 'khor thad /ra dpag tshad 'bum gnyis dang 'khor yug 'bum drug mthug rngams gong mtshungs stong phrag lnga bcu yod pa'i chu rdul gyi dkyil 'khor gyen du 'phyo ba zhig grub pa dang / de rjes chu skyor de'i nang nub kyi 'od ser po las sa'i rdul dbyar ba'i rlung me chu gsum gyi rdul dang ldan pa'i 'ja' tshon 'khrig pa'i dpe ltar mtha' yas pa'i rdul gyi dkyil 'khor chen sngo thad dkar dpag tshad 'bum gcig dang / khe ra yug 'bum gsum/ mthug rngams dkyil 'khe ra kun mtshungs stong phrag lnga bcu yod pa'i sa rdul gyi dkyil 'khor chen po zhig grub cing / rlung me chu sa'i rdul ldan gyi dkyil 'kho ra de kun dbyibs zlum snu gsum ga'ang nam mkha'i khams kyi rdul phran khyab byed du ldan ༷sa gzugs can gzhan gyi go 'byed pa ni/ bo/nga gi dus kyi stong pa rnams las rlung dang 'bar byed (me )chu dang 'dzin ma (sa )zhes pa'i rgyud tshig gis legs par bstan cad//'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor grub rjes slar de dag cher bsrubs pa'i snying po lta bu sa rdo phra spom las ri gling la sogs pa mu khyud kyi bar du grub par gsungs te/ de yang sa'i dkyil 'khor steng du 'bur dod kyi tshul gyis dbus su lhan po rgyu rdo sgom po zhes rin po che lnga'i rang bzhin can dpangs su dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig de nas lhan wa'i mgrin pa dang / gdong dang gtsug lta ra gyi tha snyad kyis phye ba'i bar snang stong par snang ba yid gzugs kyi rnam pa'i tshad rim par stong phrag nyer lnga/ lnga bcu/ nyer lnga bcas 'bum gcig grub par gsungs la/ lhan wa 'i dbyibs kyang phyi dbyibs zlum po dkar yol bslangs ba lta bu rtsabar dbus nas

36 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//khyodags mtha'i bar brgyad brgyad de bsdoms nga sa dang ga tshad bcu drug dang / de'i mtha' 'khor ho ra yug khyodang phrag gcig gis zlum por bskor ba'i steng ma rim gyis 'phel ba rwa lnga pa'i rnam pa can te rwa cadag ma gsum gyi cha re re'i mtshams nas rwa re re 'phyang ba rwa lnga nga/ steng ma ni ri rab kyi rtse dang khad mnyam pa phyogs kun tu phyir son pa bsil ri'i thod par 'gyings pa ru lnga pa'i rtse nas bsil ri'i bar gyi bya skyibs lta bu'i 'og na gnas pa'i ri mtsho gling bcu drug gi sar 'tsho ba longs spu+od sa rnams yod pa ni ru'i sanas tshul dbang gis mi mngon pa'i tshul du gnas nga 'ang / rgyud las/ ri rab lhun po stong pa'i rnam pa rdo rje masnu ga gi rang bzhin dkyil 'khor rnams kyi dbus su ste/ /(14)zhes gsungs la/ de'i phyi rol sa dkyil 'dzam gling chen wa'i rten gzhir gyur ba rnams ni las sa pa zhes bya ste rang cag gnas pa'i gling 'di'o// de yang gling bzhi ri rab 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i 'dzam gling chen po dang / lho gling gcig ngu la 'dzam gling chung ngu zhes 'dod pa'i 14 16) chags tshul yang zhar la rtogs pas tshad gzhal tshul ni gsham du 'god do/ /gnyis pa / phyi snod 'jig shen gyi tshad dpag tshad 'bum bzhi'i gzhal tshul/gling bzhi ri rab 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor dang bcas pa'i phyi snod kyi chags tshul mdor bsdus gling zin te/ da ni de dag gi tshad gzhal tshul bstan pa la/ rgyud la sa/ rlung gi mtha' nas lhan wa'i mtshams su dmyal ba gdengs can thodang khyer la ni dpag tshad 'bum phrag gnyis/ /lhun wa'i tshad ni 'bum phrag gcig ste gza' yi tshogs kyi gnas nas stong phrag dag ni nyi shu lnga/ /mgrin pa 'o sadong la lnga bcu brtan pa'i go 'phang g.yo med dag la de bzhin nyid du nyi shu lnga/ /de yi phyi rol stogeng pa gcig pu srid rngu gsum bral sku na tan med cing de nyid kyis dman pa'o/ /

'dzam gling che chung gi rnam bshad / 37(15)zhes gsungs pa ltar/ nang skye wa'i lus khru bzhi dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i phyi stod kyi 'dzam gling che chung gang yang dpag tshad 'bum bzhir gzhal tshul ni/ sngar 'byung bzhi'i dkyil 'khor ri rab gling dang bcas po'i grub tshul du gsal ba ltar/thog mar rlung dkyil gyi mtha' nas me dkyil bar thad dkar dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcur gsungs pa bzhin/ me dkyil nas chu dkyil/ chu dkyil nas sa dkyil bcas la'ang stong phrag lnga bcu re brtsis pas dkyil 'khor gyi ngos gcig pu dpag tshad 'bum gnyis su 'gyur ba de nyid nyis 'gyur du byas pa'i 'bum bzhi ni thad shar gyi dpag tshad cha ldan du 'gyur te de steng 'og dang g.yas g.yon phyogs gang nas gzhal yang 'bum bzhi'i tshad du nges so/ /yang na lha na po dpag tshad 'bum phrag gcig dang de steng mgrin gdong gtsug tor gyi tha snyad kyi phye bas snang ba yid gzugs 'bum gcig bcas bsdoms pas dpas tshad 'bum gnyis su 'gyur ba de steng rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor ngos gcig si 'bum phrag gnyis bcas pa/sa bzhir 'gyur ro/ /bzhi pa/ phyi nang mnyam nga/ra ji ltar sbyor tshul/phyi sdod dpas tshad 'bum bzhi chags tshul dang gzhal tshul 'ogs rjes de nyid nang skyes bu'i lus khru bzhi dang mnyam nga ra ji ltar sbyor tshul yang / nang ler/ 'jig rten khams kyi kun nas khor yug tu zhi thad ga'i chad kyi sasum 'gyur du yang gyur ba ste/ sa yi khor yug 'bum phrag gsum dang chu me rlung rnams kyis ni drug dgu nyi ma rim nga sa so/ /mi yi dbang pri+o phyi rol srid pa gsum gyi gnas su dang/ga tshad 'bum phrag gcig nyid gang yin pa/ /de ni sa yi steng rgi gnas su lus la rang rang dag gi tshad kyi yang das khru gang ngo / /(15)zhes dang / gso rig las 'gro

38 na pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//mchog gtso bor 'gyur pa mi lus la/ /zhes dang / 'dzam gling rang lus 'dom gang khru bzhi ste/ /(17)zhes gsungs te/ de ltar phyi snod dpag tshad 'bum bzhi de las gcig gang yin pa 'di nyid nang 'dzam gling chen wa'i las sa pa'i 'ashod mchog gtso gyur mi lus can rang rang gi tshad kyi yang dag khru gang yin de nyid tshad ldan 'bum bzhi dang sbyar ba'i khru bzhi ste 'doms gang du 'gyur ro/ /zhes pa'i don te/ 'di nyid rgyas par bshad pa la gnyis/ gcig 'gro mchog gtso 'gyur mi lus ji ltar gyur tshul/ gnyis/ phyi rol dpag tshad 'bum bzhi ldan gyi cha shas re re lus kyi yon lag bcas par sbyar te 'bum bzhi nyid khru bzhir sbyar tshul gsal bar bshad pa'/ /dang po la/ bshad rgyud zhus pa'i le'u las/ 'gro mchog gtso bor gyur pa mi lus la/ /zhes gsungs pa 'gro ba mi nyid rig drug las gathorwa bar ji ltar 'gyur tshul la/ rgyud 'grel snga phyi gnyis por dran nyi gdags 'dul mdzod sogs masnga dang bde mchog rgyud kyi dgongs pa bzhin/ las kyi sar skyes shing khams drug dang ldan pas dam pa'i chos la spyod pa'i skal ba dang ldan pa'i mi lus ni lha dang bcas pa'i 'bo/ ba gzhan rnams kyis bsngags shing spyodan pa'i gnas yin pas na 'gro ba rigs drug gi gtso bor 'gyur zhes gsungs so/ /'dir las sa zhes pa thodang du las longs gnyis su dbye ba'i 'dzam gling las 'dzam gling chen po'i gling bzhir gnas pa'i las sa pa ste rang gi las la brten nas sku ga 'tsho ba'i 'gro ba mi ni skye gnas bzhi las mngal skyes yin pa gang zhig sa dang chu me rlung nam mkha' ye tshes kyi khams drug dang ldan pa rlung sems kyi rten ma'akhor rnams yongs su rdzogs pas 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi chos nyams su blangs rung lha dang bcas pa'i 'gro ba gzhan

'dzam gling che chung gi rnam bshad / 39gyis bsngags pa'i gnas yin pas na 'bo/ ma〉〉ga gatherga 13ra 'gyur ba mi lus zhes smras pa'ang / rgyud las/ dang 10ra mtha' dag rgyal ba'i lus ni dngo sa grub rgyu ru sngags pa dag gis yang dag bsrung bar bya/ /lus med na ni dngos grub med cing skye ba 'di la mchog gi bde ba thob pa'ang med/ /(18)ces dang / lha ni mthong ba skyed min dag dang srid pa rnam bcur gsungs pa rdo rje yi ni lus dag las//sngags kyi skye gnas dag ni 'byung bar 'gyur zhing mi yi bdag 10 slar yang 'di nyid du bo la te / / (19)zhes sku gas gsungs/ casdo na 'gro ba gzhan rnams dang skye gnas gzhan gsum po ci phyir 'bras bu'i cesas nyams su blang du mi rung snyam na/ khams gsum las gzugs med pa dag ni mngal skyes min pa gang zhig khams drug yongs su ma rdzogs pa'i phyir dang / dud 'gro la sku gas mngal skyes khams drug ldan yin rung gti mug pa'i rang bzhin rlung sems kyi yo'akho ra rnal ma ma grub pas 'bras bu'i chos grub rung ba ma yin no/ /gnyis pa/ phyi roladapag tshad 'bumabazhe ldan gyi cha shasare re lus kyiyan lag bcas par sbyar te 'bum bzhi khru bzhir sbyar tshul bshad pa la/ de yang phyi rol rlung gi dkyil 'khor dpag tshad stong phrag nyer lnga zhi nang du rdo je'i lus kyi nor bu'i 'ching ba (mkhrig ma )nas lag pa'i sor rtse'i bar te mkhrig ma nas sor rtse'i bar gyi khru phyed (sor mo bcu gnyis )do/ /phyi rol me yi dkyil 'khor dpag tshad stong phrag nyer lnga ni nang du sho je'i lus kyi nye ba'i dpung pa'o zhes gru mo nas mkhrig mtshams bar gyi khru phyed do/ /phyi rol chu yi dkyila'akhor gong bzhin nang du lus kyi dpung pa'i cha la ste gru tshigs nas dpung mgo bar gyi khru phyed do/ /yang khyi rol dpag tshad stong phrag nyer lnga ni nang rdo rje'i lus kyi brang phyed de brang dbus nas dpung mgo'i bar gyi khru phyed do/ /

40 na pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yis phyogs bsdus bzhugs so//ji ltar phyi rol rlung gi mtha' nas sa dkyil bar du dpag tshad 'bum gnyis su 'gyur ba de ni nang rdo rje'i lus la brang dbus nas sor rtse bar khru do/ /phyi rol rlung dkyil (g.yas )mtha' gcig nas (g.yon )mtha' gzhan bar dpag tshad 'bum bzhir 'gyur ba ni nang rdo rje'i lus kyi lag g.yas sku ra rtse nas lag g.yon sor rtse bar tshad ldan rang rang gi khru bzhir 'gyur ba'o/ /dpangs su dpa ga tshad nyis 'bum ltar na nang rdo rje'i lus kyi long mthil nas rked pa'i bar sor zhe brgyad khru do'i bdag nyid can du gnas pa/de yang 'os nas sku ra mo drug this dbye ba'i cha re la dmyal ba dang sbyar la lhun wa'i dpangs la chig 'bum ltar na nang rdo rje'i lus kyi rked pa nas mgren 'og bar sor nyer bzhir khru gang bdag nyid can de'i gnas gza' skar khyim gyi sgo la dang /me yi 'gro ba brten pa'i gnas dang sbyar la/ gzhan phyi rol lhun wa'i mgrin par dang ga tshad stong phrag nyer lnga/ gdong la stong lnga bcu/ gtsug tor la stong nyer lngar 'gyur ba rnams ni nang rdo rje'i lus la dpral mtshams nas btsug tor rtse'i bar sor drug dang / mgrin gdong gtsug tor bcas pa la sor mo nyer bzhi ste khru gang ngo / /lnga pa// 'dzam gling che chung li mtha' dpyad rngu/ la/'dzam gling che chung gi gling slong ba dang / de 'brel phri snod chags tshul dang tshad gzhal tshul/ de nyid nang the rje'i lus la sbyar tshul bcas gsal bar smras zin tshul gyis/ da ni gso rig rgyud las gsungs pa'i 'dzam gling che chung de nyid dngos don gang du ngos bzung 'thad pa 'i mtha' dbya da la/ sngar byon rgyal sra sa byang chub sems pa dag this gdul bya'i mos khams dang dbang po/ yul dus sanas skabs satso

'dzam gling che chung gi rnam bshad / 41bor dgongs te rdzo gling 'di nyid kyi mi rnams la/ lho 'dzam gling gi mi rnams ni 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi chos grub rung mngal skyes khams drug ldan rdo rje'i lus mi lus tshad ldan du gsungs te de'i tshad kyang tshad ldan phyi stod dpag tshad 'bum bzhi ldan gyi 'dzam gling dang mnyam par sbyar te khru bzhir gsungs pa las gling gzhan pa'i mi la mtha' dpyad ma mdzad pa ni/ gling de dang de skabs babs gsang sngags kyi chodas dar sa'i gnas ma yin pas gling de'i mi rnams la tshad de ltar dmigs bkar gsungs pa dar+sha sa pa cher mi ldan pa dang / gling gzhan gyi 'acad ba rnams skabs babs kyi gdul bya ma yin par mkhyen te gling 'di'i (lho gling )gdul bya rnams 'bras bu'i chos grub pa la spro ba mngon du phyogs pa'i phyir gsungs bar snyam/ gzhan yang /bzhed tshul kha cig ltar na lto gling las gling gzhan mngal skyes ma yin par sgong skyes lha/gas skye gnas gzhan yin par bstan te 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi cesas grub pa'i rten rdo rje'i lus dang mi ldan par gsungs pa'ang / gling rang rang gi mi rnams thog mar skye gnas mi 'dra ba sgong skyes mngal skyes sku gas nas 'byung bar bstan pa sus kyang 'di ni ma yin ca/ zhes kha cho na gcod dka' ba dang / rgyu mtshan gzhan zhig ni gong bshad bzhin gdul bya spro ba skyed pa'i ched du dmigs so/ /de ltar yin du zin kyang da lta'i char/ gling gzhan mngal skyes khams drug ldan 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi chos grub rung yin pa khas len dalha sa pa ni dpal dus kyi 'kho ra 'o/ las/ lhan 16re rgyab kyi lhu gas rnams su ni sa gzhi dag la lha min rnams kyis rgyal bar dka' ba 'bor/ /gang du chos ni rnam par nyams shing rtsod dus 'jug pa de dang der ni rab tu bgrod par byed/ /ces dus kyi 'khor lo'i zab chos 'di nyid ma 'ongs 'dzam gling phyogs gzhan kun tu rab tu dar bar byed pa'i lung gsal

5 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig khyodags bsdus bzhugs sku //bar bstan pa ltar/ bdag cag gi ston pa'i lung gis zin pa'i sku sprul 7rgyal ba bstan 'dzin rgya mtsho mchog gis deng mi dge kla klo'i dpung dag 'joms phyir zhi bsil chodas kyi gdams pa gling gzhan pa'i gdul bya rnams la bstan dang stodan bzhin yod pa lta ci/ 'byung 'gyur ye lo nyis stong bzhi brgya tsam gyi nang rigs ldan drag po 'khor lo can gyis kla klo'i tshogs bcom ste de rjes lha dbang gis rim bzhin sa'i dum bu bcu gnyis kyi gnas su 'bras bu'i chos bstan par gsungs pa sogs dngos shugs ci rigs pa'i sgo nas grub bo/ /'o na gling de dag (a ri byang gling dang / dbyin ji nub gling sogs )gi mi rnams kyi lus la khru bzhi ldan nam mi ldan snyam na/ rgyud las bstan bzhin tshad ldan rang rang gi khru bzhi ni nges par du ldan dgos te/ phyi yul gyi tshad gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas par dpag tshad 'bum bzhi yod pas rtogs la/ skabs don rgyud tshig tu/ 'dzam gling rang lus 'doms gang khru bzhi/ /zhes pa'i 'dzam gling 'di nyid 'dzam gling chen por sngo sa bzung gis 'dzam gling chen wa'i las sar gnas pa'i mi rnams mngal skyes khams drug ldan 'bras bu gsang sngags kyi chos grub rung mi lus tshad ldan phyi yul gling bzhi ri rab dang bcas pa dpag tshad 'bum bzhi dang sbyar nas khru bzhir 'dod pa 'thad ldan du mthong bas gzur gnas mkhyen ldan kun gyis legs par dpyad ma༄dud zhes nan gyis zhu bcan/ /yang kha cig na re/ gso ba rig pa'i gzhung 'dir lus 'di'i tshad rtogs na 'grig mod kyi khyod ltar na 'dzam gling che chung dang phyi nang sogs kyi bshad pa byed pa rnyog ma gting stsodang yin no snyam pa'i phyi nang rten 'brel gyi gnad zur tsam yang mi rtogs pa'i gtam smra na/ gsham 'khod lung rigs kyis 'gog nus la/ ci

'dzam gling che chung gi rnam bshad / 43ste khyod lta bu'i blo yul du/ sgra ji bzhin dang ji bzhin min/ /dgongs pa'i skad dang de bzhin min/ /drang ba'i don dang nges don no/ /zhes pa'i rgyud bzhi mtha' drug gi 'grel tshul chodar chud rgyu ༄/sa bral rgyud 'grel cha tsam zhig kyang shong du med do / / rgyud kyi tshig 'bru dang ming gcig tsam smras par yang don du ma ldan te 'di la snang chung dang khyad gsod bya ga la rung / rgyud nang sangs rgyas 'grub rung gi gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag gsungs sku da pas tshig 'di 'dra ba re re'i steng nas ro myong dgos kyi gzhan du logs su lam 'di'o/ /rgyud 'di'o zhes bya ba 'tshol 'dod pa ni/ bu ram la lces mi myong bar bu ram gyi ro gzhan zhig nas 'tshol 'dod pa dang gnyis su med pa'i phyir ro/ /drug pa/ lus gnas 'dir dmigs su 'dzam gling gi tshad gsungs pa'i dgos pa dang 'dzam gling che chung gi rnam bshad rtogs pa des gso thabs rig pa'i lag len nang dgos khyad gang ldan bshad pa/sangs rgyas sman bla'i rnam sprul rig pa'i ye shes mched bzhis bstan pa'i rgyud 'di'i 'phrin las spel yul ni 'dzam gling chen wa'i 'gro ba nad pa spyi dang / khyad par skabs babs 'gro drug las gtso bor gyur pa mi'i lus rten 'di nyid yin cing / de lta bu'i lus rten 'di nyid kyang phyi snod kyi 'byung ba lnga las 'phro dgos shing / phyi'i 'byung lngas sdod kyi rten grub pa 'i rten 'brel khyad 'phags la ltos nas nang mi'i lus wa'i grub tshul gsung bas/ nang bcud kyi dngos po spyi dang khyad par mi'i lus rten gyi 'byung bzhi'i nad phra rags rtogs par phyi snod 'dzam gling snod kyi chags tshul dang tshad gzhal tshul ci nas kyang rtogs dgos te 'chad gyur lus gnas bstan pa'i skabs kyi sku/ grangs sku gnyis dang / rus dum sum brgya drug cu/ sgal tshig

5 e pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig phyo gas bsdus bzhugs sku //nyer brgyad/ yan lag tshigs chen bcu gnyis dang / nang gi ma'adab so so'i grangs la sogs nang sho je'i lus kyi phra rags gnad ji snyed phyi'i stod dang sbyor tshul gsungs pa'ang rgyud las/ sa dang chu me rlung dang rdo rje lha yi gzhu dang rlung rnams dang ni khyim gyi 'khor lo dang / /zla ba nyi ma sgra gcan lhan po gdengs can mi dang lha yi gnas dang 'khyodag po skar ma bcas/ /'pho ba zla ba dag dang phyogs dang nyin dang mtshan mo tshes rnams mtha' dag lus kyi dbus su ni/ /rang rang ye gos shes bya rnam gsum khyab bdag bgrod pa rnal 'byor pa yi stong pa'i dbye bas so/ /(20)zhes gsungs pa las stodags shing / gzhan yang 'dzam gling che chung gi tshad shes pas nyi zla gza' skar gyi bgrod yul gnam sa'i go la'i tshad rtogs pa dang / de rtogs pas nyi ma lto byang gi bgrod pa'i tshad rtogs pa des phyi rol dus bzhi'i 'gyur ba phra zhib rtogs shing / de nyid rtogs pas nang lus wa'i rtsa'i rgyu ba dang der ltos pa'i nad gzhi'i khams ji snyed 'phyugs med gsal bar shes par ma zad/ nyes gsum gasku/ga ldang gi gnad ka phra mo 'ang shes nus pas nad gasku thabs rig pa'i thog dgos gal ci ste med/ de bzhin 'di las 'phros te nad kyi gnyen po a ru ra sku gas sman rigs kyi ro'i gnas tshul 'ga' gling bar 'dod kyang re zhig dus dbang gi rtsal stobs ci rigs dang yig chosags 'phel ba sogs la dogs te nyung ngur byas so//zhes pa'ang gasku rtsis smra ba'i gral 'dzin e pa bsnu da nams rin chen gyis sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// //

'dzam gling che chung gi rnam bshad / 45༄༅༅/ /dpyad gzhi'i yig cha dang dang dpe mtshan/1) zur mkhar mnyam nyid rdo rje'i rigs chos kyi dbon po slo gros rgyal po'am legs bshad 'tshol du grags pas zhus chen gyis gtan la phabs pa nang lha/ yar rgyab pas par du brkos pa'i grwa thang rgyud bzhi/ de la'ang dpyad pas ma khyab pa'i nor lus kyi rnyog ma phran bu byung ba rnams 7mi dbang sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i rnam dpyod kyi ke ta gas bgrungs pa'i lha gdan ngo ta la'i par ma/ de nyid slar 'byu len gyis phyi mo zhus te sde dge bstan pa tshe ring gis par du btab pa sde dge par mar grags pa/ de nyid slar mtsho sngon mi rigs par 'debs bzo grwa nas par du btab pa'i gso rig rgyud bzhi par thengs gnyis pa'i shog ang / 663 phreng / da par gsal/('di man rgyud bzhi zhes 'aspo da rgyu/)2) rigs ldan 'jam dpal grags pas bsdus pa'i masnumag gi dang sngo'i sangs rgyas las phyung ba rgyud kyi rgyal dze dpal dus kyi 'khor 'o/ bstan 'gyur rgyud/ (tha 19na(gsham du/ rgyud/ (ba zhes 'bo da rgyu/)3) gong mtshungs bstan 'gyur rgyud/ (tha 21na4) sde srid sangs rgyas mtshos mdzad pa'i phug lugs rtsis kyi legs bshad pi dkar/5) rgyud bzhi las phyi rgyud le'u 27 dze/gas grangs 663 phreng 106 7) tshan rig pa zhig gis sangs rgyas codas lugs la zhib 'jug byas pa'i snyan cad/ dbyig tri po'o yis brtsams/8) bstan 'gyur rgyud/ (tha 19ba9) gso rig rgyud bzhi las bshad rgyud/ le'u 19 shog grangs 62 phreng 7

46 o pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig chu gas bsdus bzhugs so///10) bstan 'gyur rgyud/(tha cadag grangs/ 99 'phreng 'dzin tshigs bcad 18611) ( na dha ri'am sum stodan ye shes kyis mdzad pa'i gso rig rgyud bzhi las bshad rgyud 'grel pa 'bum nag gsal cadan/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun pa/ sna ga ang 25 nang gsal/12) mchodag gi dang wa'i sangs rgyas las phyung ba rgyud kyi rgyal wa dpal dus kyi 'kho ra 'o/ phyi 'jig rten kham le/ bstan 'gyur rgyud (tha na na13) bstan 'gyur rgyud/ (tha da ba14) bstan 'gyur rgyud/ (tha ba15) bstan 'gyur rgyud/ (tha ba16) bstan 'gyur rgyud/ (tha shog grangs/ 317) gasku rig rgyud bzhi las bshad rgyud le'u 4 cadag grangs/ dan18) bstan 'gyur rgyud/ (tha par gsal/19) bstan 'gyur rgyud/ (tha sna(ga grangs/ 220) bstan 'gyur rgyud/ (tha sna/ga grangs/ 19

༄༅༅/ /spar kha brgyad kyi brda mtshon phyag rgya 'bri tshul la dpyad pa cung zad gling ba gtsug lag smra ba'i lag rjes//81swasti: gdod nas sgrib kun bral ba'i lha lam na//'gro blo'i bag nyal sna ngas mun kun sel gnyen//mkhyen rab nyi mar brtse chen 'od stong can//khyab bdag 'jam dpal dpa' bos rtag tu khyodangs//zhes gtsug lag rtsis kyis ma〉rgan pa'i shes bya'i gnas kun gyi mkhyen rab kyi lhag pa'i lha bcom ldan 'das khyab bdag 'jam dpal dpa' bo la skyabs kyi yul dam par bzung ba'i rim pa sngon du phul nas/ re zhig gling bar bya ba'i brjod gzhi ni spar kha brgyad kyi mthu lha/bas 'dus pa'i brda macesan phyag rgya 'bri tshul nyo ra yin zhing / deng gi char spar kha'i phyag rgya 'bri tshul nyo ra la gtsug lag smra ba'i mkhas dbang dag gis phyag rgyun mi 'dra ba du ma zhig snang ba 'di dag las/ zhags nag spyi chings kyi rgyud las byung ba'i khams pa khra mo'i 'gyur rnying gi lugs dang / kun 'byung a lo'i lugs gnyis sngo/ las gzhan rnams ni gang zhig gang gi lugs dang gang zhig gang las byung ba sogs ni g.yam rgyug bshad sgros tsam las ci yin snyam pa'i rang gi chod cadar dogs snang gi sa bon phra mo skyes pa cung zad dpyad khul dang 'brel yi ge'i lam du 'god par 'dod pa 'dir nongs 'khrul gyi dri ma gang mchis gzur gnas blo ldan dag gis byi dor yong ba'i smon 'dun dang bcas 'dir 'bri ba la/ de yang / thog mar gleng bar bya ba'i chos 'di'i brjod bya'i gzhi gang las 'phros/ rjod byed gang

48 ye pa'i sman rtsis dpyad yig chu gas bsdus bzhugs so//du grub/ tshul ji lta bu'i lam nas brjod/ brjod gzhi'i rgyu'am dpe gang / brjod pa'i rkyen gang / brjod pa po'i gang zag su dang bcas kyi dang por/ brjod bya'i gzhi ni bdag cag gi rdo na pa bka' drin can gyis chodas kyi lha mtha' yas par bstan pa'i snying sngo rten cing 'brel 'byung gi chos las/ rgyu dang 'bras bu'i rnam gzhag las 'aho/sa pa'i rten 'brel gyi cesas tshul zhig bo/ /gnyis par/ rjod byed ni ma rig 'khrul pa'i snang ngor gsungs pa'i gtsug lag 'byung ba'i rtsis so/ /gsum par/ tshul ji lta bu'i lam nas brjod pa ni rgyu las kyi rnam par smin pa'i 'bras bu de yang rkyen nyer len gyi phung wa'i steng du 'byung ba 'grams 'khrugs gathe da 'dral sku gas kyis ji ltar masngo na pa'i tshul gsal bar bstan pa zhig go /bzhi par/ brjod gzhi'i rgyu'am dpe ni ma hā gser gyi rus sbal shes rab kyi bdag nyid de'o/ /lnga par/ brjod pa'i rkyen ni yul rus sbal gyi lus la spar kha brgyad kyis gtsos pa'i 'byung ba rtsis kyi skor mgo'i mtshan nyid ma lus ji ltar tshang ba'i tshul/ yul rkyen rig pa'i sngo ru 'khrul bral ji bzhin 'char ba las so/ /drug par/ bcadad pa wa'i gang zag su zhig ce na/ 'di la'ang / thun min dang / thun mong gnyis las/ /thun min la/ dang sngo / bcadad pa wa'i gang zag ni/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sku 'chang mngal skyes spangs pa'i skur bstan 'jam dpal dbyangs so/ /gnyis pa/ brjod pa'i gnas ni 'phags mchog snying rje'i gter chen gyi gdul zhing bod rgyal khab chen po'i dbang phyogs rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga la'o/ /gsum par/ brjod
